utv.uk.title: Julia Bradbury's Wonders of the Frozen South - Antarctica
utv.uk.description: Documentary series. Julia Bradbury journeys to the edge of the world to experience the beauty and brutal conditions of Antarctica as she explores its icy landscapes and extraordinary wildlife - after crossing the Southern Ocean, Julia navigates through thick and jagged brash ice in bays framed by snow-covered peaks. On a whale-spotting mission, penguins and seals surround Julia's boat before a pod of humpback whales finally breaks cover to breath and feed in the bay - donning snowshoes to trek over challenging terrain, she then learns about the harsh reality of life on the ice. During an emotional overnight camp in the stunning Paradise Bay, Julia reflects on her life, family and health - studying the colours and shapes of the icebergs at close quarters, Julia then experiences the raw power of nature as a giant iceberg splits in two and crashes into the ocean just a few metres away, a dramatic end to an extraordinary journey. - 2026

channel4north.uk.description: Channel 4's midday news summary.

channel4north.uk.title: Renovation Nation
channel4north.uk.description: In Yorkshire, Byron attempts a sash window restoration, while Naomi is determined their honeymoon suite will be fit for royalty. Have Faye and David reached the end of the road? (Ep9/20)

channel4north.uk.title: The Great House Giveaway
channel4north.uk.description: Model Alaw and technical engineer Harri fix up a Wrexham terrace with no kitchen or bathroom, that hasn't been touched since the day it was built. Can they flip it for a profit?

channel4north.uk.title: Countdown
channel4north.uk.description: Colin Murray, Rachel Riley and Susie Dent host, with Nicki Chapman in Dictionary Corner, as contestants race against the clock to pit their wits against vowels.

channel4north.uk.title: A Place in the Sun
channel4north.uk.description: Emma and John have fallen in love with stunning Seville. Jasmine Harman shows them modern apartments and turn-key retreats, all within their budget of £150k.

channel4north.uk.title: Help! We Bought a Village
channel4north.uk.description: The new series continues. In Normandy, Hayley and Lee have a hard time with concrete. In Andalucía, Clare discovers an old mill stone hiding in plain sight.

channel4north.uk.title: Four in a Bed
channel4north.uk.description: In Lisburn, Neil and Rush host the week's final visit at their luxurious B&B and spa. Their place is plush - but cold eggs at breakfast prove to be a real turn-oeuf.

channel4north.uk.title: Come Dine with Me
channel4north.uk.description: In Sheffield, Lindsey serves up some antioxidant-stuffed dishes. But her soup is ruthlessly likened to baby food and her main makes a guest retch at the table. (Ep4/5)

channel4north.uk.title: A New Life in the Sun: Where...
channel4north.uk.description: ...Are They Now?: In Portugal, holiday hosts set themselves a new challenge. In Spain, a former café owner works out her next move as she fights to keep her Spanish dream alive.

channel4north.uk.title: Channel 4 News
channel4north.uk.description: Channel 4's flagship news programme. Including the weather.

channel4north.uk.title: Becca's Story: Stand Up To Cancer
channel4north.uk.description: A short film for Stand Up To Cancer. Becca had a zest for life and dreamed of becoming a doctor. But shortly after qualifying, she was diagnosed with an aggressive form of ovarian cancer.

channel4north.uk.title: Our Tiny Islands
channel4north.uk.description: From unique wool on Iona and croft craft on North Uist to surveying Pembrokeshire's seals, we meet the people who live on their islands by virtue of their jobs.

channel4north.uk.title: New: Taskmaster
channel4north.uk.description: A Taskmaster legend is in the house. All but one of the contestants enjoy a short and steamy train ride. And Nina Conti tries to trick Greg Davies with bananas and a big spoon.

channel4north.uk.title: New: Break Clause
channel4north.uk.description: January: Romcom series. Lil and Ben bunk off work to enjoy a day out together in London. But when Ben finds out some unpalatable truths about Lil's timeline, things turn nasty... (Ep5)

(Documentary, Animals, Miniseries, Nature) - 2016

eden.uk.plus1.title: Wild Japan - Honshu

eden.uk.plus1.title: New Zealand: Earth's Mythical Islands - Cast Adrift
eden.uk.plus1.description: Isolated since the time of the dinosaurs, New Zealand's wildlife has been left to its own devices - with surprising consequences. Its ancient forests are still stalked by predators from the Jurassic era. It's also one of the most geologically active countries on Earth. From Kiwis with their giant eggs, to forest-dwelling penguins and helicopter-riding sheep dogs, meet the astonishing creatures and resilient people who must rise to the challenges of their beautiful, dramatic and demanding home. (Documentary, Animals, Miniseries, Nature) - 2016

eden.uk.plus1.title: New Zealand: Earth's Mythical Islands - Wild Extremes
eden.uk.plus1.description: The most extreme and wild parts of New Zealand are in the South Island, which lie towards Antarctica, in the path of the tempestuous `roaring forties'. This is home to some of the most rapidly rising mountains in the world, the Southern Alps. From hyper-intelligent parrots, to sinister snails with teeth and magical constellations of glow-worms, this is the story of New Zealand's wildest places and its most resilient pioneers, all of who must embrace radical solutions to survive. (Documentary, Animals, Miniseries, Nature) - 2016

E4+1.uk.description: S27 E14 Gal of Constant Sorrow Bart offers a talented homeless woman the chance to live in his wardrobe. Homer messes up when he tries to prove his DIY skills.

E4+1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4+1.uk.description: S27 E15 Lisa the Veterinarian The Simpsons escape the chill of winter by visiting an indoor water park. Lisa complains to her mother after Bart blasts her hair spikes with a water cannon, so Marge banishes Bart to the kiddie pool.

E4+1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4+1.uk.description: S27 E16 The Marge-ian Chronicles Lisa signs up for a one-way ticket to Mars, forcing Marge to employ a devious strategy to keep her daughter on Earth.

E4+1.uk.title: Hollyoaks ᴺᵉʷ
E4+1.uk.description: E123 Episode 123 Mercedes' birthday gets off to a rocky start. And a chase ensues when Imran finds Lucas in Chester, but things take a dangerous turn.

E4+1.uk.title: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
E4+1.uk.description: S2 E11 Stakeout Charles and Jake's relationship is impacted during an eight-day stakeout in close quarters. Elsewhere, Rosa takes notice of Capt. Holt's nephew.

E4+1.uk.title: First Dates
E4+1.uk.description: S12 E6 Episode 6 Dating hopefuls include a builder who is finally ready for a concrete relationship, a naked bike rider, a pair of gamers, and a man who has been married five times already.

E4+1.uk.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA ᴺᵉʷ
E4+1.uk.description: S3 E10 Lyla's Family Restaurant Part 2 Owner Waleed's hopes and dreams literally go up in flames when a fire breaks out at his restaurant's big relaunch.

E4+1.uk.title: Gogglebox
E4+1.uk.description: S20 E3 Episode 3 Britain's sharpest armchair critics have been watching: The State Funeral of HM Queen Elizabeth II, 'The Masked Dancer', 'Frozen Planet II', 'Bad Sisters', 'The Grand Tour: A Scandi Flick', 'Secret Crush' and BBC News.

E4+1.uk.title: Gogglebox
E4+1.uk.description: S20 E4 Episode 4 Britain's sharpest armchair critics have been watching 'Strictly Come Dancing', 'Coronation Street', 'Antiques Roadshow', 'Frozen Planet II', 'Kings of Pain', 'Help! My House Is Haunted', 'Only Connect', and ITV News on the mini-budget.

E4+1.uk.title: First Dates
E4+1.uk.description: S2 E8 Episode 8 Cheeky bank manager Ross visits the restaurant for the third time. Ross has been single for three years, and hopes that primary school teacher Sarah-Jayne will be his third time lucky. Will sparks fly with Sarah-Jayne's ice-breaker games?

E4+1.uk.title: Gogglebox
E4+1.uk.description: S20 E3 Episode 3 Britain's sharpest armchair critics have been watching: The State Funeral of HM Queen Elizabeth II, 'The Masked Dancer', 'Frozen Planet II', 'Bad Sisters', 'The Grand Tour: A Scandi Flick', 'Secret Crush' and BBC News.

E4+1.uk.title: Below Deck Down Under
E4+1.uk.description: S3 E3 Walking on Eggshells Harry makes his move with Brianna, but just as sparks begin to fly, he suffers an injury. Wihan ignites tension within the ranks when he oversteps Lara's department. And things heat up in the galley as Anthony contemplates leaving his position.

E4+1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4+1.uk.description: S20 E20 Four Great Women and a Manicure The female members of the Simpson household make a trip to a nail salon and discuss whether a woman can be successful without a man at her side. Marge and Lisa each tell their own parodies of 4 classical stories, including Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs.

E4+1.uk.title: The Goldbergs
E4+1.uk.description: S10 E3 Jenkintown After Dark Adam calls Brea, despite promising to keep distance so they can each establish themselves at college, sending Beverly into a tailspin; Joanne lands a coveted job at a posh Philly law firm.

E4+1.uk.title: The Goldbergs
E4+1.uk.description: S10 E4 Man of the House With everyone preoccupied with the new baby on the way, Erica's graduation is met with lacklustre enthusiasm from Beverly and Geoff; Adam's new job is in jeopardy; Barry tries to be the new man of the house.

E4+1.uk.title: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
E4+1.uk.description: S2 E11 Stakeout Charles and Jake's relationship is impacted during an eight-day stakeout in close quarters. Elsewhere, Rosa takes notice of Capt. Holt's nephew.

E4+1.uk.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
E4+1.uk.description: S1 E5 Olde Stone Mill Chef Gordon Ramsay works his magic on a New York state eatery that has been renovated but still has horrible service and food.

E4+1.uk.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
E4+1.uk.description: S2 E4 Mojito's Gordon visits Mojito, a Cuban café in Brooklyn, New York. Owners Marcelo and Kata used to be married to each other but now fight over everything. Seven years ago, the couple were happy newlyweds and the restaurant was their shared dream, but now the passion has gone, and they're constantly at each other's throats, with their staff getting caught in the crossfire.

E4+1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4+1.uk.description: S5 E13 Three Dinners While Jay struggles to digest some news from best pal Shorty, Cam and Mitch take a break from the wedding planning to enjoy a romantic dinner.

E4+1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4+1.uk.description: S5 E14 iSpy Gloria is suspicious of Jay after he says baby in a dream. Phil and Claire spy on Haley, Luke and Manny. Mitchell is reluctant to share some juicy gossip with Cameron.

E4+1.uk.title: Rude(ish) Tube
E4+1.uk.description: Shorts A short, cheeky clip from Rude Tube's naughty little sister, featuring sports of the lawnmower, motorcycle and bicycle variety.

E4+1.uk.title: Couples Come Dine with Me
E4+1.uk.description: East Kent In east Kent, outspoken estate agent Sean and his girlfriend Beth kick off the competition with a Welsh-themed menu. Day two sees Marcus and Miguel lay on a Malaysian feast, but Sean's teasing of his girlfriend steals the limelight.

E4+1.uk.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
E4+1.uk.description: S1 E15 Trobiano's Chef Gordon Ramsay visits Trobiano's of Great Neck, N.Y., an Italian restaurant that is a half-million dollars in debt; during a confrontation with the owner about the cleanliness of the kitchen and the quality of the food, Ramsay walks out.

E4+1.uk.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
E4+1.uk.description: S1 E19 Jack's Waterfront Gordon helps out at Jack's Waterfront in St Clair Shores, Mich., a lakeside restaurant in a popular summer spot.

E4+1.uk.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
E4+1.uk.description: S3 E3 PJ's Steakhouse Gordon travels to Queens, New York to visit PJ's Steakhouse, a restaurant he quickly discovers is all sizzle and no steak. Owners Joe and Madalyn have found themselves in serious debt after opening the high-end restaurant. The couple were overcome by grief when Joe's brother PJ passed away. Struggling to move on they decided to take over the lease of PJ's bar and turn it into a restaurant.

E4+1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4+1.uk.description: S2 E14 Bixby's Back It's Valentine's Day and that can only mean one thing, the return of Clive Bixby. Plus, Mitchell's PA proves problematic and Jay and Gloria get competitive.

E4+1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4+1.uk.description: S2 E15 Princess Party DeDe has come back to town to celebrate Lily's second birthday, and she's brought some baggage from the past with her.

E4+1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4+1.uk.description: S15 E18 Catch 'Em if You Can When Marge and Homer are caught enjoying a romantic weekend in Miami instead of a boring family visit to Dayton, Bart and Lisa embark on a cross-country journey to hunt them down and ruin their holiday. Grandpa, abandoned in Miami, enjoys the company of gay Miami swinger Raoul.

E4+1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4+1.uk.description: S15 E19 Simple Simpson Homer becomes an anonymous vigilante, shaming Springfield's miscreants by splatting them with pies, but can Mr Burns blackmail the Pie Man into pieing the Dalai Lama?

E4+1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4+1.uk.description: S15 E20 The Way We Weren't Homer and Marge learn they were destined to be together when Homer tells the story of his first kiss.

E4+1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4+1.uk.description: S15 E21 Bart-Mangled Banner The Simpsons are thrown in prison for high treason after Bart accidentally moons the American flag. Their only hope is an old man with an escape plan.

E4+1.uk.title: The Goldbergs
E4+1.uk.description: S3 E20 Dungeons and Dragons, Anyone? Adam betrays his friends after becoming captain of the gym class. Erica encounters resistance from Beverly and Murray when she decides she wants to go to college.

E4+1.uk.title: The Goldbergs
E4+1.uk.description: S3 E21 Rush Beverly smothers Barry when he tells her that she favours Adam. Meanwhile, Murray is not happy about Erica's new boyfriend who is a Rush fanatic.

E4+1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4+1.uk.description: S3 E11 Lifetime Supply After having a doctor's visit and then missing the call with the test results, Phil automatically jumps to conclusions and starts saying his goodbyes. Meanwhile, Javier pops up unannounced again and takes Manny to the horse races for a belated birthday celebration.

E4+1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4+1.uk.description: S3 E12 Egg Drop Luke and Manny have a big school project to design the best capsule that would protect an egg in a two-story drop, but when Claire and Jay catch wind of it, their own competitive drives kick in. Meanwhile, Phil solicits the help of Haley and Gloria to sit as plants in the audience during a huge real estate presentation he has put together.

E4+1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4+1.uk.description: S3 E13 Little Bo Bleep The family helps Claire prepare for her upcoming televised debate with Duane Bailey for the town council seat, but will they do more harm than good? Meanwhile, Lily is going to be a precious flower girl for the first time, but the problem is that she's just discovered her first expletive and Mitch and Cam don't know how best to deal with this new parenting test.

E4+1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4+1.uk.description: S3 E14 Me? Jealous? Phil is so preoccupied with impressing his new business partner, that he doesn't notice him being overtly inappropriate with Claire. Meanwhile, four is a crowd at Jay and Gloria's.

E4+1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4+1.uk.description: S27 E17 The Burns Cage Homer makes it his mission to find Smithers a boyfriend and signs him up to a dating app. Meanwhile, Bart messes with the school's stage show.

E4+1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4+1.uk.description: S27 E18 How Lisa Got Her Marge Back Inside a giant factory in Guangdong Province, China, a child works tirelessly applying stickers to a practical joke novelty toy called Money Grabber. The toy eventually ends up in Bart's possession.

E4+1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4+1.uk.description: S27 E19 Fland Canyon One night, Homer sings to Maggie, hoping the sound of his voice will lull her to sleep. When that fails, Maggie shows her father a board book containing the story Little Red Riding Hood. Homer has read the book aloud many times, so he decides to tell the baby a different tale.

E4+1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4+1.uk.description: S27 E20 To Courier with Love Homer makes a deal with a travel agent to be the courier of a top-secret briefcase to get a discount on a family holiday to Paris.

E4+1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4+1.uk.description: S20 E21 Coming to Homerica An outbreak of food poisoning at Krusty's restaurant chain is traced back to tainted barley in nearby Ogdenville, settled years earlier by Norwegian immigrants. Ogdenville Barley Mills is promptly shut down and Springfield finds itself swamped by the unemployed.

E4+1.uk.title: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
E4+1.uk.description: S2 E12 Beach House Jake ruins a detectives-only getaway to Charles' beach house by inviting Holt. Charles helps Rosa be romantic with her new boyfriend, and Gina tries to get Amy drunk.

E4+1.uk.title: First Dates
E4+1.uk.description: S12 E7 Episode 7 61-year-old Italian restaurant owner Giovanni thinks he can give Fred a run for his money on the charm front. And Jason has to try and see past Tyrone's ADHD for a successful date.

E4+1.uk.title: Gogglebox
E4+1.uk.description: S20 E5 Episode 5 Britain's sharpest armchair critics have been watching 'Bad Sisters', 'Nadiya's Everyday Baking', 'The Kardashians', 'Super/Natural', 'A Trip to Infinity', BBC News (energy cap), and BBC News (Kwasi U-turn).

talkingpictures.uk.title: Francis Durbridge's A Man Called Harry Brent
talkingpictures.uk.description: The Pen. 1965. Stars Edward Brayshaw, Gerald Harper & Jennifer Daniel. Mrs Tolly's husband puts a devious plan in action to obtain Mr Fielding's fountain pen. (Entertainment)

talkingpictures.uk.title: Payday - 1973. Director
talkingpictures.uk.description: Daryl Duke. Stars Rip Torn, Ahna Capri & Elayne Heilveil. Maury Dann, a not-so-nice country-western singer, ruthlessly manipulates everyone around him to suit his selfish needs. (Documentary, Movie) - 2016

talkingpictures.uk.title: There is Another Sun
talkingpictures.uk.description: Directed by Lewis Gilbert. Laurence Harvey is 'Mag Maguire' a fairground boxer and Maxwell Reed, 'Eddie Racer' a motorbike daredevil rider. The mutual love interest is the lovely Susan Shaw. (Crime, Movie) - 1951

talkingpictures.uk.title: Bullet Scars
talkingpictures.uk.description: 1942. Crime Drama. Directed by D. Ross Lederman. Stars Regis Toomey, Adele Longmire & Howard Da Silva. A doctor and a nurse are forced to treat a wounded gangster who was injured during a robbery. (Crime, Drama, Movie) - 1942

talkingpictures.uk.title: Look At Life Submarine
talkingpictures.uk.description: 1960. A look at life in a submarine and the work that is carried out within. (Entertainment)

talkingpictures.uk.title: The Directors
talkingpictures.uk.description: Federico Fellini was an Italian film director and screenwriter. Known for his distinct style he is recognized as one of the greatest and most influential filmmakers of all time. (Entertainment)

talkingpictures.uk.title: The Man from U.N.C.L.E
talkingpictures.uk.description: The Adriatic Express Affair. 1965. Stars Robert Vaughn & Jessie Royce Landis. Solo and Kuryakin ride the Adriatic Express to Venice, seeking a THRUSH virus that could wipe out the human race. (Entertainment)

talkingpictures.uk.title: Sherlock Holmes - The Case of the French Interpreter. 1954. Starring
talkingpictures.uk.description: Ronald Howard, Howard Marion-Crawford & Archie Duncan. When an interpreter says he was kidnapped, Sherlock investigates further. (Entertainment)

talkingpictures.uk.title: Sons Of The Sea
talkingpictures.uk.description: 1939. Drama. The Head of Dartmouth training college is murdered but was he the intended victim? Directed by Maurice Elvey. Starring Leslie Banks and Kay Walsh. (Drama, War, Movie) - 1939

talkingpictures.uk.title: Paul Temple's Triumph
talkingpictures.uk.description: 1950. Nettlefold Films production directed by Maclean Rogers and starring John Bentley & Dinah Sheridan. Paul Temple is on the hunt for a kidnapped scientist who's invented a secret formula. (Crime, Mystery, Thriller, Movie) - 1950

talkingpictures.uk.title: The Treasure of San Teresa - 1959. War. Director
talkingpictures.uk.description: Alvin Rakoff. Stars Eddie Constantine, Dawn Addams, Marius Goring, Christopher Lee. Ex-serviceman, Larry, returns to Europe to retrieve jewels hidden from the Nazis in 1944. (Action & Adventure, Movie) - 1968

talkingpictures.uk.title: Tarnished Heroes
talkingpictures.uk.description: 1961. War. Directed by Ernest Morris. Stars Dermot Walsh & Patrick McAlinney. Major Bell and a ragtag team undertake a dangerous mission to destroy a bridge of strategic importance to the enemy. (Drama, War, Movie) - 1961

talkingpictures.uk.title: The Buccaneers
talkingpictures.uk.description: Spy Aboard. 1957. Stars Robert Shaw, Richard Johnson & Danny Green. Tempest is robbed by the ruthless pirate Peg Leg and comes to the realisation that there is a spy aboard the Sultana. (Entertainment)

talkingpictures.uk.title: Hindle Wakes
talkingpictures.uk.description: 1952. Drama starring Leslie Dwyer and Lisa Daniely. Successful remake of one of the earliest British talkies. Set in the Hindle, two mill workers take off to Blackpool for the 'Wakes' holiday. (Drama, Romance, Movie) - 1927

talkingpictures.uk.title: Look At Life Chicken In The Mill
talkingpictures.uk.description: 1961. A look into the new industrial revolution in Lancashire; from 1950, more than 55 cotton mills were converted for light industries. This film examines the change for Lancashire's workers. (Entertainment)

talkingpictures.uk.title: Dial 999
talkingpictures.uk.description: Ghost Squad. 1958. Stars Robert Beatty, Russell Napier & Douglas Wilmer. Maguire is sent to the London docks as a part of the 'Ghost Squad' to investigate a number of thieves operating there. (Entertainment)

talkingpictures.uk.title: Obsession - 1949. Thriller. Director
talkingpictures.uk.description: Edward Dmytryk. Stars: Robert Newton, Sally Gray & Phil Brown. A cuckolded psychiatrist kidnaps his wife's lover and hides him away while he plans his revenge. (Drama, Mystery, Movie) - 2023

talkingpictures.uk.title: Rooms
talkingpictures.uk.description: Mr Cotgrove & Miss Hicks P1. Michael Gwynn, Annette Crosbie & Jane Wenham. Mr Cotgrove lives very much alone on the first floor. He's 50 and a teacher at a comprehensive. (Entertainment)

talkingpictures.uk.title: Rooms
talkingpictures.uk.description: Mr Cotgrove & Miss Hicks P2. Michael Gwynn, Annette Crosbie & Jane Wenham. Over dinner, Mr Cotgrove tells Miss Hicks why he is living in a bedsitter in Barons Court. (Entertainment)

talkingpictures.uk.title: Out of Town
talkingpictures.uk.description: British Finches/Yerro's Operation. 1986. Jack sees almost every member of the British finch family in a country garden before recounting the story of his noisy mule, Yerro. (Entertainment)

talkingpictures.uk.title: Dick Turpin
talkingpictures.uk.description: The Pursuit. 1979. Stars Richard O'Sullivan, Michael Deeks & Stacy Dorning. After being robbed, Dick and Swiftnick pursue a masked highwayman down a trail leading towards a country house. (Entertainment)

talkingpictures.uk.title: Van der Valk
talkingpictures.uk.description: A Man of No Importance. Stars Barry Foster, Michael Latimer & Susan Travers. When a dead man turns up on the deck of a canal barge, everyone is ready to dismiss him as a nonentity. (Entertainment)

talkingpictures.uk.title: Francis Durbridge's A Man Called Harry Brent
talkingpictures.uk.description: The Problem. 1965. Stars Edward Brayshaw, Gerald Harper & Jennifer Daniel. Alan shares the discovered films with Carol, a discussion forces him to confide in her. (Entertainment)

talkingpictures.uk.title: Francis Durbridge's...
talkingpictures.uk.description: A Man Called Harry Brrent. Tolly Changes His Mind. 1965. Stars Edward Brayshaw, Gerald Harper & Jennifer Daniel. Carol disappears after Harry explains what's going on, Tolly confesses to a lie. (Entertainment)

talkingpictures.uk.title: Francis Durbridge's A Man Called Harry Brent
talkingpictures.uk.description: The Third Person. 1965. Stars Edward Brayshaw, Gerald Harper & Jennifer Daniel. Alan enlists the help of Carol to set a trap for the killer. (Entertainment)

talkingpictures.uk.title: The Cassandra Crossing - 1976. Drama. Director
talkingpictures.uk.description: George P Cosmatos. Stars Sophia Loren, Richard Harris, Burt Lancaster & Martin Sheen. Passengers of a European train can't escape after a deadly virus is planted. (Drama, Movie) - 1996

talkingpictures.uk.title: Dick Tracy Returns
talkingpictures.uk.description: 1938. Actions. Directors John English & William Witney. Stars Ralph Byrd, Lynn Roberts & Charles Middleton. Tracy battles spies and saboteurs in his efforts to bring to justice the Stark gang. (Action, Crime, Movie) - 1938

talkingpictures.uk.title: Scotland Yard - 1957. Bullet from the Past. Director
talkingpictures.uk.description: Kenneth Hume. Stars Ballard Berkeley, Robert Sansom and Philippa Hyatt. An inspector investigates the shooting of a man connected to an old cold case. (Entertainment)

talkingpictures.uk.title: Stagecoach West
talkingpictures.uk.description: Blind Man's Bluff. Wayne Rogers & Robert Bray run a stagecoach line in the Old West, where they come across a wide variety of killers, robbers and ladies in distress. (Entertainment)

talkingpictures.uk.title: Batman
talkingpictures.uk.description: Hi Diddle Riddle. 1966. Stars Adam West, Burt Ward & Neil Hamilton. The Riddler's twisted trail leads Batman to break the law and fall before the criminal charms of a beautiful Molehill Mob moll. (Entertainment)

talkingpictures.uk.title: Batman
talkingpictures.uk.description: Smack in the Middle. 1966. Stars Adam West, Frank Gorshin & Jill St. John. The Riddler holds Robin hostage to lure Batman into a trap that could mean the end of the Caped Crusader. (Entertainment)

talkingpictures.uk.title: Sherlock Holmes
talkingpictures.uk.description: The Case of the Singing Violin. 1954. Stars Ronald Howard, Howard Marion-Crawford & Archie Duncan. Betty is being tormented by apparent hallucinations, so her fiancé calls Sherlock and Dr Watson. (Entertainment)

talkingpictures.uk.title: The Voice Of Merrill
talkingpictures.uk.description: 1952. Crime Drama. Directed by John Gilling. Starring Valerie Hobson, James Robertson Justice & Sam Kydd. A dying author frames a radio narrator for killing his secretary. (Mystery, Movie) - 1952

talkingpictures.uk.title: What's On TPTV With Noel
talkingpictures.uk.description: Founder of Talking Pictures TV and one half of the Footage Detectives, Noel Cronin, shares shows and films not to be missed throughout October. (Entertainment)

talkingpictures.uk.title: No Trace
talkingpictures.uk.description: 1950. Drama. Directed by John Gilling. Writer Robert Southley finds his lifestyle threatened by blackmail from a former US criminal associate. Stars Hugh Sinclair, Dinah Sheridan & John Laurie. (Drama, Movie) - 2021

talkingpictures.uk.title: The Crooked Sky
talkingpictures.uk.description: 1957. Crime drama directed by Henry Cass. An American detective & Scotland Yard must work together to crack a counterfeit gang. Stars Wayne Morris, Karin Booth and Anton Diffring. (Drama, Movie) - 1957

talkingpictures.uk.title: The Spider and the Fly
talkingpictures.uk.description: 1949. Crime. Directed by Robert Hamer. Stars Eric Portman, Nadia Gray & George Cole. An unusual love triangle develops between two criminals and a policeman on the eve of the first World War. (Animation, Comedy, Movie) - 1931

talkingpictures.uk.title: The Duchess of Duke Street
talkingpictures.uk.description: Trouble and Strife. 1976. Stars Gemma Jones, John Cater & Maureen O'Brien. A woman from Starr's past, down on her luck, begs him to use his influence to obtain a job for her at the Bentinck. (Entertainment)

talkingpictures.uk.title: High Tide
talkingpictures.uk.description: 1980. Thriller. A man just released from prison for manslaughter heads to the West Country to solve the mystery behind his victim's cryptic last words. Stars Ian McShane, Wendy Morgan & John Bird. (Drama, Romance, Movie) - 2024

talkingpictures.uk.title: Look At Life Any Old Iron
talkingpictures.uk.description: 1962. A look at the people who prepare salvaged steel to be re-used, also with a glimpse at the steel foundries which melt it all down again. (Entertainment)

talkingpictures.uk.title: Julius Hagen Season
talkingpictures.uk.description: Join Noel as he introduces the delightful musical comedy Squibs from 1935, and provides an insight into Julius Hagen's part in making the film. (Entertainment)

talkingpictures.uk.title: Squibs
talkingpictures.uk.description: 1935. Comedy. Directed by Henry Edwards. Stars Betty Balfour. A cockney flowerseller, Squibs with a father overwhelmed by gambling debts wins through with the help of assorted friends. (Movie) - 1935

talkingpictures.uk.title: Julius Hagen Season
talkingpictures.uk.description: Tune in to find out which brilliant Julius Hagen film will be shown next week. (Entertainment)

talkingpictures.uk.title: Strange But True?
talkingpictures.uk.description: Bigfoot/Ouija Boards. 1997. Michael Aspel speaks to Todd Neiss about his apparent bigfoot sighting and are Ouija boards just a bit of fun or more dangerous than we know. (Entertainment)

talkingpictures.uk.title: The Brothers
talkingpictures.uk.description: Loneliness. 1974. Stars Richard Easton, Hilary Tindall & Rio Fanning. Brian and Ann both face the problems of loneliness. Meanwhile, the Hammonds are invited to Sir Neville's for a shooting party. (Entertainment)

talkingpictures.uk.title: Mark Saber
talkingpictures.uk.description: Luger For Chesser. 1957. Stars Donald Gray, Sarah Lawson & Gladys Boot. A man with no friends or enemies is killed. The finger of suspicion points at his ex-wife who has come into his money. (Entertainment)

talkingpictures.uk.title: The Wheeltappers and Shunters Social Club
talkingpictures.uk.description: 1975. Roger Whittaker and Saffron perform 'New World In The Morning', 'The Seasons Come and the Seasons Go', and Helen Shapiro performs 'Lean On Me'. (Entertainment)

talkingpictures.uk.title: The Killing Of Sister George
talkingpictures.uk.description: 1968. Drama. Directed by Robert Aldrich. Stars Beryl Reid, Susannah York, Coral Browne, Patricia Medina & Ronald Fraser. An aging actress faces the loss of her popular television role. (Comedy, Drama, Movie) - 1968

amc.us.title: House on Haunted Hill
amc.us.description: A millionaire with theatrical tendencies, Stephen Price (Geoffrey Rush) invites a number of people to stay in a vast creepy building that used to be an insane asylum. Stephen, accompanied by his bitter wife, Evelyn (Famke Janssen), offers a million dollars to anyone who can stay the whole night without leaving out of fear. When Stephen and Evelyn become trapped with their guests, they quickly realize that the house really is haunted -- and the spirits dwelling within are very angry. (Horror) - 1999

amc.us.title: House of Wax
amc.us.description: A gang of college friends, including Wade (Jared Padalecki) and his girlfriend, Carly (Elisha Cuthbert), are en route to a school football game when they wind up with a flat tire in a ghost town. They are forced to seek help in the only place that's open: the local wax museum. Once inside the spooky and seemingly abandoned building, they find the works on display are not quite what they seem -- and the group soon discovers it's being hunted by the insane twin brothers who run the museum. (Horror) - 2005

amc.us.title: Thirteen Ghosts
amc.us.description: A state-of-the-art remake of the classic William Castle horror film about a family that inherits a spectacular old house from an eccentric uncle. There's just one problem: the house seems to have a dangerous agenda all its own. Trapped in their new home by strangely shifting walls, the family encounters powerful and vengeful entities that threaten to annihilate anyone in their path. (Horror, Thriller) - 2001

amc.us.title: Ghost Ship
amc.us.description: In a remote region of the Bering Sea, a boat salvage crew discovers the eerie remains of a grand passenger liner thought lost for more than 40 years. But once onboard the eerie, cavernous ship, the crew of the Arctic Warrior discovers that the decaying vessel is anything but deserted. It's home to something more deadly and horrific than anything they've encountered in all their years at sea. (Horror, Thriller) - 2002

amc.us.title: Trick 'r Treat
amc.us.description: Interwoven stories demonstrate that some traditions are best not forgotten as the residents (Anna Paquin, Brian Cox, Dylan Baker) of a small town face real ghosts and goblins on Halloween. Tales of terror reveal the consequences of extinguishing a Jack-o-Lantern before midnight and a grumpy hermit's encounter with a sinister trick-or-treater. (Holiday, Horror, Thriller) - 2007

amc.us.title: Jeepers Creepers 2
amc.us.description: After his son is set upon by a scarecrow that seems to have come alive, farmer Jack Taggart Sr. (Ray Wise) and his son, Jack Taggart Jr. (Luke Edwards), go looking for an explanation. Meanwhile, a bus carrying high-school students breaks down nearby, and a creature known as the Creeper (Jonathan Breck) starts a killing spree. The elder Taggart soon realizes that the killings and the attack on his son are connected, and, after alerting the community to be on guard, he aims to pummel the Creeper. (Horror, Thriller) - 2003

amc.us.title: Night of the Living Dead
amc.us.description: For reasons unknown, the recently deceased are rising from the grave as flesh-hungry zombies. Fleeing from the undead horde, a small group of survivors, including Barbara (Patricia Tallman), Ben (Tony Todd) and Harry (Tom Towles), sequester themselves in a remote farmhouse. With the zombies outside the house multiplying, tensions flare, as the group argues over the best way to escape their increasingly dire situation before they are overrun completely. (Horror) - 1990

amc.us.title: Motel Hell
amc.us.description: Vincent Smith (Rory Calhoun) and his sister Ida (Nancy Parsons) run a rural hotel, but they earn most of their cash operating a food stand that specializes in world-famous sausages. After years of success, however, the duo's upstanding brother, Sheriff Bruce (Paul Linke), eventually discovers the grotesque details of his siblings' booming business: Vincent and Ida are actually plumping up their hotel patrons, killing and dismembering them and then grinding them into frankfurters. (Horror, Dark comedy) - 1980

amc.us.title: Candyman: Farewell to the Flesh
amc.us.description: As her brother stands trial for the killing of an outspoken New Orleans professor, inner-city schoolteacher Annie Tarrant begins hearing rumors of the Candyman, a murderous, knife-handed figure of urban legend. Skeptical of the Candyman's existence, Annie follows the procedure for summoning him and suddenly finds herself celebrating the most horrifying Mardi Gras of her life. Meanwhile, Annie's mother harbors a dark family secret. (Horror, Thriller) - 1995

amc.us.title: Halloween III: Season of the Witch
amc.us.description: Hospital emergency room Dr. Daniel "Dan" Challis (Tom Atkins) and Ellie Grimbridge (Stacey Nelkin), the daughter of a murder victim, uncover a terrible plot by small-town mask maker Conal Cochran (Dan O'Herlihy), a madman who's planning a Halloween mass murder utilizing an ancient Celtic ritual. The ritual involves a boulder stolen from Stonehenge, the use of Silver Shamrock masks and a triggering device contained in a television commercial -- all designed to kill millions of children. (Holiday, Horror, Thriller, Mystery, Science fiction) - 1982

amc.us.title: The Thing
amc.us.description: In remote Antarctica, a group of American research scientists are disturbed at their base camp by a helicopter shooting at a sled dog. When they take in the dog, it brutally attacks both human beings and canines in the camp, and they discover that the beast can assume the shape of its victims. A resourceful helicopter pilot and the camp doctor lead the camp crew in a desperate, gory battle against the vicious creature before it picks them all off, one by one. (Horror, Science fiction) - 1982

amc.us.title: Halloween
amc.us.description: On a cold Halloween night in 1963, six-year-old Michael Myers brutally murdered his 17-year-old sister, Judith. He was sentenced and locked away for 15 years. But on October 30, 1978, while being transferred for a court date, a 21-year-old Michael Myers steals a car and escapes Smith's Grove. He returns to his quiet hometown of Haddonfield, Illinois, where he looks for his next victims. (Holiday, Horror, Thriller) - 1978

amc.us.title: Christine
amc.us.description: Unpopular nerd Arnie Cunningham (Keith Gordon) buys a 1958 Plymouth Fury, which he names Christine. Arnie develops an unhealthy obsession with the car, to the alarm of his jock friend, Dennis Guilder (John Stockwell). After bully Buddy Repperton (William Ostrander) defaces Christine, the auto restores itself to perfect condition and begins killing off Buddy and his friends. Determined to stop the deaths, Dennis and Arnie's girlfriend, Leigh Cabot (Alexandra Paul), decide to destroy Christine. (Horror) - 1983

amc.us.title: It
amc.us.description: Seven young outcasts in Derry, Maine, are about to face their worst nightmare -- an ancient, shape-shifting evil that emerges from the sewer every 27 years to prey on the town's children. Banding together over the course of one horrifying summer, the friends must overcome their own personal fears to battle the murderous, bloodthirsty clown known as Pennywise. (Horror, Thriller) - 2017

amc.us.title: The Conjuring
amc.us.description: In 1970, paranormal investigators and demonologists Lorraine (Vera Farmiga) and Ed (Patrick Wilson) Warren are summoned to the home of Carolyn (Lili Taylor) and Roger (Ron Livingston) Perron. The Perrons and their five daughters have recently moved into a secluded farmhouse, where a supernatural presence has made itself known. Though the manifestations are relatively benign at first, events soon escalate in horrifying fashion, especially after the Warrens discover the house's macabre history. (Horror, Thriller) - 2013

amc.us.title: The Haunting in Connecticut
amc.us.description: When their son Matt (Kyle Gallner) receives a diagnosis of cancer, Sara (Virginia Madsen) and Peter (Martin Donovan) Campbell move to Connecticut to be closer to his doctors. At first all is well, but then Matt becomes increasingly disturbed by what appears to be paranormal activity. Sara turns to a priest for help, and the ghosts are seemingly banished -- but Matt's condition takes a sudden and unexplained turn for the worse, and the lives of Sara and the rest of her family are endangered. (Horror, Thriller) - 2009

amc.us.title: Poltergeist
amc.us.description: Strange and creepy happenings beset an average California family, the Freelings -- Steve (Craig T. Nelson), Diane (JoBeth Williams), teenaged Dana (Dominique Dunne), eight-year-old Robbie (Oliver Robins), and five-year-old Carol Ann (Heather O'Rourke) -- when ghosts commune with them through the television set. Initially friendly and playful, the spirits turn unexpectedly menacing, and, when Carol Ann goes missing, Steve and Diane turn to a parapsychologist and eventually an exorcist for help. (Horror, Thriller) - 1982

amc.us.title: Halloween 4: The Return of Michael Myers
amc.us.description: The apparently comatose Michael Myers (George P. Wilbur) is being transferred from one hospital to another, but he wakes up when the ambulance crew talk about his surviving niece, Jamie (Danielle Harris). After slaughtering his attendants, Myers sets out to find his one living relative who is, fortunately, being cared for by a kind and resourceful foster sister named Rachel (Ellie Cornell). Meanwhile, the ever-cautious Dr. Loomis (Donald Pleasence) remains on the killer's path. (Holiday, Horror) - 1988

amc.us.title: Halloween 5: The Revenge of Michael Myers
amc.us.description: After lying in a coma for a year, Michael Myers (Donald L. Shanks) awakens and stalks his way back to his small hometown in Illinois, intent on killing his niece, Jamie (Danielle Harris), who has been confined to a mental institution since Michael's last attempt to slay her. Suspecting a psychic link between Michael and Jamie, psychiatrist Dr. Sam Loomis (Donald Pleasence) joins forces with Sheriff Ben Meeker (Beau Starr) and attempts to stop Michael's latest rampage. (Holiday, Horror) - 1989

amc.us.title: Halloween II
amc.us.description: A year after narrowly escaping death at the hands of Michael Myers (Tyler Mane), Laurie Strode is at the breaking point, pushed to the edge by Dr. Loomis' (Malcolm McDowell) revelation that she's Michael's sister. Little does she know, the unstoppable killer is back in Haddonfield and, driven by visions of their dead mother (Sheri Moon Zombie), he is determined to bring about a bloody family reunion. (Holiday, Horror, Thriller) - 2009

mlbnetwork.us.description: MLB Network's first-ever talk show is an open forum that features some talk and a lot of banter each weekday for host Kevin Millar, who discusses with special guests what's hot and what's not in and around the national pastime. He also runs out of the baseline at times by welcoming guests from the worlds of entertainment and pop culture to talk about trending topics in those arenas. Millar gained fame as a member of the 2004 world champion Boston Red Sox, and since he retired from the diamond his knowledge of the game and warm, affable personality have vaulted him into a lengthy career in the media. (Baseball) - 2011-07-13

mlbnetwork.us.title: MLB Central ᴸᶦᵛᵉ
mlbnetwork.us.description: MLB Network's first-ever regular-season morning show features hosts Robert Flores, Mark DeRosa and Lauren Shehadi reporting from Studio 21, named in honor of Hall of Famer and humanitarian Roberto Clemente. Updates and context on the latest news, extensive on-field highlights, and long-form conversations with guests, celebrities and insiders from around baseball are presented each weekday morning. Flores joined the network in 2016 as a host/reporter, DeRosa offers a unique outlook as a former player, and Shehadi honed crisp interviewing skills during three years of hosting MLB Network's "The Rundown." (Baseball) - 2015-04-06

mlbnetwork.us.title: MLB Now ᴸᶦᵛᵉ
mlbnetwork.us.description: The hourlong weekday afternoon "MLB Now" presents the day's top stories in baseball by spanning the sport's cultural divide. Host Brian Kenny discusses the issues and provides analysis, with a bent toward modern analytics to prove his points. The series also features interviews with personalities throughout the game, and viewer opinions are welcome as well via social media polls. (Baseball) - 2013-04-01

secnetwork.us.title: The Paul Finebaum Show ᴸᶦᵛᵉ
secnetwork.us.description: Veteran writer, reporter and radio personality Paul Finebaum built a legion of loyal sports fans as the "Voice of the SEC" during 20 years hosting his Birmingham, Ala.-based radio talk show. When ESPN launched the SEC Network in 2014, it was only natural that Finebaum became its first on-air hire, bringing his radio show -- and those passionate followers -- with him. Now originating from one of the SEC Network studios in Charlotte, N.C., the show is a forum for lively discussion and debate of all things SEC and across the spectrum of college sports, with Finebaum playing the role of both moderator and provocateur. The show airs weekday afternoons throughout the year on SEC Network. (Sports talk, Interview) - 2013-12-02

syfywest.us.title: Texas Chainsaw Massacre: The Next Generation
syfywest.us.description: After leaving their prom early, innocent Jenny (Renée Zellweger) and three other teenagers crash their car in the backwoods of Texas. In their search for help, they run into Vilmer Slaughter (Matthew McConaughey), a vicious psychopath with a mechanical leg, and his twisted family, including the serial killer Leatherface. As the group of friends struggle to survive the maniacal methods of torture, Jenny discovers the secret origins behind the family's lust for blood. (Horror) - 1995

syfywest.us.title: Halloween
syfywest.us.description: Nearly two decades after being committed to a mental institution for killing his stepfather and older sister, Michael Myers breaks out, intent on returning to the town of Haddonfield, Ill. He arrives in his hometown on Halloween with the indomitable purpose of hunting down his younger sister, Laurie. The only thing standing between Michael and a Halloween night of bloody carnage is psychologist Dr. Samuel Loomis. (Holiday, Horror, Thriller) - 2007

syfywest.us.title: Halloween II
syfywest.us.description: A year after narrowly escaping death at the hands of Michael Myers (Tyler Mane), Laurie Strode is at the breaking point, pushed to the edge by Dr. Loomis' (Malcolm McDowell) revelation that she's Michael's sister. Little does she know, the unstoppable killer is back in Haddonfield and, driven by visions of their dead mother (Sheri Moon Zombie), he is determined to bring about a bloody family reunion. (Holiday, Horror, Thriller) - 2009

syfywest.us.title: Old

syfywest.us.title: The Intruder
syfywest.us.description: Scott and Annie Russell couldn't be happier after buying their dream home from a mysterious and lonely widower named Charlie in Napa Valley, Calif. Their newfound paradise soon turns into a living nightmare when Charlie -- still strangely attached to the house -- begins to show up and interfere in their daily lives. When his erratic behavior turns to obsession, the young couple soon find themselves caught up in a violent confrontation that threatens to destroy everything they hold dear. (Thriller, Drama) - 2019

700407.title: Garden Rescue
700407.description: The team help Richard and Darren create a slice of New York's 'High Line' garden in Solihull. The garden has famously turned a disused train line into a thriving garden, mixing contemporary paving, grass planting and historical leftover train tracks.

700407.title: Garden Rescue
700407.description: In Warrington, the team answer an SOS from ten-year-old Oliver, their youngest applicant ever. Bike-mad Oliver wants something that no one else has ever asked the designers for: a BMX track in his back garden.

700407.title: Garden Rescue
700407.description: The team are in Leamington Spa to help Robert and Gemma and their young daughter Darcey. The family want a place where Darcey can come out and play without fear of falling into nettles or injuring herself on the uneven and broken patio.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: Hellebores, the jewels of the early spring border, come under the spotlight on this show. Monty Don shares his top tips on how to get the best from them. Carol Klein visits a couple who have just moved into a bungalow with a badly neglected garden.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: Monty Don explains why he thinks that the once-popular chrysanthemum is worth revisiting and Joe Swift has some helpful suggestions if you're thinking of giving your garden a bit of a spring revamp.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: Monty Don plants up a new bed of asparagus and shows us how to lift and divide hostas. On our second visit to South Africa, we explore the conditions that allow agapanthus to thrive in the wild.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: At Longmeadow, Monty Don breaks ground for his new pond and Carol Klein pays Geoff and Sally Davis another visit in their Somerset garden. Their overgrown shrubs are in need of a jolly good haircut, but they haven't a clue where to begin.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: As the weather begins to warm up, there's plenty to be getting on with in the garden. Monty Don welcomes us to Longmeadow and cracks on with some timely tasks. Including Water Iris Garden, Peonies, Seaside Garden, National Gardening Week.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: Magnolias are the showstoppers of the tree world right now and to celebrate them in all their glory, James Alexander-Sinclair pays Borde Hill Garden in West Sussex, with its collection of magnificent champion trees, a visit.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: Everything in the garden is shooting up so it's time to lift and divide perennials and Monty is doing just that with his ornamental grasses. In our third trip to South Africa, we discover where red hot pokers grow in the wild.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: As Monty's wildlife garden begins to take shape at Longmeadow, bees are very much at the forefront of his mind. He plants up a nectar-rich border that will attract all sorts of bees and other pollinating insects.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: With the hanging basket season well and truly underway, Joe Swift meets a florist in Surrey who has perfected the art of kokedama, a modern take on the hanging basket. Houseplants come under the spotlight too.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: For the National Gardens Scheme, over 400 gardens in England and Wales will be opening to the public. Carol Klein visits one of them as they prepare for the big event. At Longmeadow a local beekeeper arrives with a swarm for Monty's new hive.

700407.title: Monty Don's Spanish Gardens
700407.description: Monty travels across Central Spain. He begins at the vast, imposing palace and garden of the Escorial before heading for Madrid, Toledo, other parts of Castile and finally Valencia.

700407.title: Monty Don's Spanish Gardens
700407.description: Monty Don is in the south of Spain, visiting gardens that show how this part of the country has evolved thanks to influences from visitors and settlers from ancient to modern times.

700407.title: Monty Don's Spanish Gardens
700407.description: Monty Don travels across northern Spain, visiting gardens across this vast and diverse landscape that changes from an Atlantic to a Mediterranean climate as he journeys from Galicia to Catalonia.

700407.title: Big Dreams, Small Spaces
700407.description: In Brighton determined duo Helen and Dax have their hands full with twins, one of whom has special needs. Meanwhile in High Wycombe, newly single Valerie is looking for a fresh lease of life.

700407.title: Big Dreams, Small Spaces
700407.description: Monty Don visits two sets of ambitious gardeners, each facing challenges on a very different scale. One is a tiny urban courtyard in Hackney and the other is a outdoor area for a community.

700407.title: Big Dreams, Small Spaces
700407.description: Monty meets two sets of gardeners who have unimaginable ambitions for their outdoor spaces. In Essex Denise has never ventured beyond the decking area behind her house. Meanwhile in Ipswich, a father and daughter plan to build a terraced allotment.

700407.title: Big Dreams, Small Spaces
700407.description: Monty comes to the rescue of two couples in need of help transforming their rubble filled back gardens into havens of peace and tranquillity. They are in serious need of help and advice but can Monty set them on the right track?

700407.title: Big Dreams, Small Spaces
700407.description: Two gardeners, each living on their own, are hoping Monty can help them. In Blackpool, Alex dreams of turning her boring back yard into a magical enchanted forest. Also in Bristol, Ross has taken on a very over-grown allotment.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: With autumn fast approaching, Monty is preparing the borders for the change of seasons and looking ahead to spring. Adam Frost and Advolly Richmond visit a glorious historic garden in North Yorkshire - Scampston Hall.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: Monty shows how to take cuttings from herbs, prune summer raspberries and plant daylilies. Meanwhile, Adam travels to Whitstable on the Kent coast to see how gardeners cope with the wild, wet and windy weather.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: With autumn on the horizon, the seasonal planting of bulbs for spring-flowering begins at Longmeadow. Frances Tophill meets a gardener whose allotment is filled with both traditional and exotic vegetables and Toby Buckland visits The Newt in Somerset to find out about its chequered garden history and to explore its emergence as one of the UK's most exciting gardens.

700407.title: Monty Don's Adriatic Gardens
700407.description: Monty begins in the city of Trieste, close to Italy's border with Croatia, to visit a public garden first created by an obsessive royal plantsman more than 150 years ago, which is now being carefully restored. He then heads down the Adriatic coast through Croatia to pick up the trail that the Venetians followed, ending his journey on the beautiful island of Lopud, near Dubrovnik.

700407.title: Monty Don's Adriatic Gardens
700407.description: Monty travels to Europe and explores the influence of the Venetians on gardening. To begin with, he explores Venice on one of the city's famous barges, stepping out to visit green spaces large and small that are often hidden from view behind high walls.

700407.title: Monty Don's Adriatic Gardens
700407.description: Monty begins the last leg of his journey in Corfu, a Greek island with strong Venetian links, including olive trees planted by them that are still grown today. Here, Monty visits a spectacular garden made by an Englishman with Greek connections.

700407.title: Monty Don's British Gardens
700407.description: Monty Don travels from the north west coast of Scotland to the north east coast of England, from historic reconstructions to modern re-inventions. He visits some of the most inhospitable places in the country and finds gardens that are flourishing.

700407.title: Monty Don's British Gardens
700407.description: Monty travels across some of the country's landscapes, heading across the north of England to Northern Ireland. Here, Monty sees the ingenuity, passion and determination of British people to garden and create gardens, no matter what the canvas.

700407.title: Monty Don's British Gardens
700407.description: Monty travels across the middle of the country, from Wales to Norfolk. He comes across gardens for gnomes, much-loved, well-tended allotments and extravagant gardens that bankrupted their owners.

677011.title: MasterChef
677011.description: After a tough elimination challenge, the Top 12 junior home cooks face their next task when the judges test their senses in a blind taste challenge. Each contestant will blindly taste a dish prepared by Gordon Ramsay and then must recreate the dish. The contestant with the dish that best reflects Gordon’s dish will receive a significant advantage. In the next team challenge, the junior home cooks will prepare VIP dishes for a dining room of all grandmothers for their first restaurant challenge. Each team will create a unique dish of “new” ingredients and the team with the most votes will be safe from elimination. Find out who will move on to the Top 10 and who will leave.

677011.title: MasterChef
677011.description: In the next team challenge, the junior home cooks will face an egg-cellent challenge and compete in pairs to see who can complete the most deviled eggs in 12 minutes. The team that perfects the most deviled eggs will be safe from the next elimination challenge, in which contestants must create their future cookbook’s signature dish. In the second hour, Christina Tosi brings a special guest into the MASTERCHEF kitchen, her mom, to present the next mystery box challenge, which will feature all of Christina’s favorite childhood foods. Then, contestants will compete in a tag team platter challenge using international street food ingredients.

673498.title: The Tall T
673498.description: The victims must outsmart their cruel captors after an outlaw, and his gang kidnap an heiress, her nervous husband, and a rancher.

673498.title: Coroner Creek
673498.description: A gunfighter (Randolph Scott) loses his beloved in a robbery and hunts the man (George Macready) to blame, who is living off the loot.

673498.title: Apache Ambush
673498.description: On a cattle drive to Kansas after the Civil War, an ex-Union soldier comes up against Apache and Confederate renegades.

673498.title: The Mountain Men
673498.description: Two old-time Wyoming fur trappers (Charlton Heston, Brian Keith) try to protect a runaway Indian (Victoria Racimo) from her angry ex-mate.

673498.title: End of the Trail
673498.description: An Indian sympathizer accused of running guns to the Arapaho is court-martialed by the man who framed him.

673498.title: Alvarez Kelly
673498.description: Alvarez Kelly (William Holden) is a Mexican cattle rancher who is doing his best to stay out of the Civil War. He has no interest in which side may win or lose -- Kelly is far more concerned about his own survival, and about making money. He soon finds himself in the middle of the conflict, however, when a confederate colonel (Richard Widmark) captures the rancher and forces Kelly to help his soldiers steal a nearby herd of cattle, which they desperately need for food.

673498.title: The Doolins of Oklahoma
673498.description: Old West outlaw Bill Doolin (Randolph Scott) marries a deacon's wife, but his gang will not leave him alone.

673498.title: Seminole Uprising
673498.description: An Army lieutenant (George Montgomery) is ordered to go after Florida Indians in Texas.

673498.title: One Man Law
673498.description: Settlers and a sheriff catch on to a Chicago swindler's land scam.

673498.title: Riders of Black River
673498.description: A former Texas Ranger's plans to marry are complicated by his future brother-in-law's involvement with cattle rustlers.

673498.title: Ten Wanted Men
673498.description: Rancher John Stewart (Randolph Scott) prefers to to resolve problems without falling back on violent solutions. However, fellow cattleman Wick Campbell (Richard Boone) isn't so peaceful, and he hires a team of armed mercenaries, led by ruthless Frank Scavo (Leo Gordon), to rid him of any possible competition. After narrowly surviving an attack from Scavo and his men, Stewart has little choice but to fight back in order to save both his ranch and his family, including nephew Howie (Skip Homeier).

673498.title: Good Day for a Hanging
673498.description: When the local sheriff is killed after a bank robbery, ex-lawman Ben Cutler (Fred MacMurray) collars the apparent killer, Eddie Campbell (Robert Vaughn). Because of his background as a local youth who spent time living with the Cutlers, Eddie gets the benefit of the doubt from Ben's daughter and his wife-to-be, Ruth (Margaret Hayes). Ben is firm in his belief that Eddie is guilty, and as the matter is debated in a divisive court battle, it will soon become clear whether or not he's right.

673498.title: Phantom Stagecoach
673498.description: A dispute between stage lines ends with a steel-armored stagecoach.

673498.title: Last of the Comanches
673498.description: A cavalry sergeant (Broderick Crawford) leads soldiers, civilians and an Indian (Johnny Stewart) on a desert trek.

673498.title: The Texas Rangers
673498.description: The Civil War has ended, the Union Army has pulled out, and now the Texas Rangers are needed once again to protect their state from harm. The newly reformed Rangers decide to take a chance by hiring a notorious outlaw Johnny Carver (George Montgomery). They offer the desperado amnesty for his previous crimes if he'll put his famous trigger finger to work for Texas. Carver agrees, but his new job won't be easy, as his old rival, the Sundance Kid (Ian MacDonald), is out for vengeance.

673498.title: Return to Warbow
673498.description: Three escaped convicts return to collect the money that the brother of one of them has already spent.

673498.title: Jubal
673498.description: Searching for work, cowboy Jubal Troop (Glenn Ford) arrives in a small town, where he badly injures his hand. Fortunately, a local rancher, Shep Horgan (Ernest Borgnine), is willing to employ Troop despite the injury. Horgan and Troop work together amicably, but Horgan's two-timing wife (Valerie French) threatens to create discord when she becomes interested in Troop, although he really loves another woman. A jealous cowhand (Rod Steiger) complicates matters by spreading lies.

673498.title: Dirty Little Billy
673498.description: After his family moves to a frontier town in Kansas, city-bred teenager Billy Bonney (Michael J. Pollard) finds he has no appetite for farming. He runs away, taking up with local outlaw Goldie (Richard Evans), who operates a saloon in town with the help of a prostitute named Berle (Lee Purcell). The three form a gang of sorts, menacing the locals until the townsfolk collectively decide to drive the outlaws away. Bonney escapes and begins the life of crime that makes him famous as Billy the Kid.

692051.title: Fear Itself
692051.description: Family man is in a bad accident. As he hovers between life and death, the guy in the bed next to him, a serial killer, switches bodies with him.

692051.title: Silent Hill: Revelation
692051.description: After spending years on the run with her father, Heather discovers her true identity, which has made her the target of a dangerous cult.

692051.title: Uninvited
692051.description: When a mutated cat escapes a lab study, it becomes the unlikely foil to a shady businessman’s banking scam aboard a yacht headed to the Caribbean.

692051.title: Demonic Toys
692051.description: A tough policewoman and five other adults get trapped in a warehouse full of possessed toys that come to life with different murderous specialties.

692051.title: Masters of Horror
692051.description: For the staff of a womens clinic, the ultimate nightmare is waiting to explode. Trapped inside is a terrified pregnant 15-year-old. Outside is her crazed anti-abortion activist father.

692051.title: Masters of Horror
692051.description: A movie programmer (Norman Reedus of TV's THE WALKING DEAD) searches for the holy grail of cinema, a legendary lost movie whose sole showing drove its audience insane.

692051.title: The Slumber Party Massacre
692051.description: Trish's slumber party for her basketball teammates includes an unexpected guest.

692051.title: Hell House LLC II: The Abaddon Hotel

692051.title: The Exorcist III
692051.description: A police lieutenant seeks answers in a psychiatric ward, when he ties a string of current murders to those of a serial killer executed long ago.

692051.title: Dresden Files

692051.title: Messiah of Evil

692051.title: Silent Night, Deadly Night Part 2
692051.description: A mental patient tells his psychiatrist how he became a killer, after his brother died during their childhood, because of a certain Mother Superior.

692051.title: Fear Itself

641290.title: Siegfried & Roy: The Original Tiger Kings
641290.description: At the height of their fame, groundbreaking magicians Siegfried & Roy were the highest-paid entertainers in Las Vegas history, globally renowned for blending magic with their astonishing killer-cat interactions. Millions of tickets were sold, billions of dollars were made, and tiger mania swept the nation. But life in the ultra-exotic world of Siegfried & Roy may not have always been what it seemed, as the magicians lived by the art of illusion off stage as well-painstakingly crafting myths about their relationships with their tigers and even with each other. Then after building that empire based on smoke, mirrors and giant cats, Siegfried & Roy's longstanding world of illusions was destroyed by one fateful onstage encounter with an angry tiger in front of a sold-out audience. That horrifying act of violence shocked the world, unleashed a torrent of wild conspiracy theories, and forever redefined the magicians' legacy.

400000088.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter

400000088.description: Dog knows that crime and drugs not only damage victims but also harm the families of the perpetrators, especially the kids. And both of the fugitives he's chasing today have left shattered families and struggling women in their wake.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In August 1992, a man returned to his Memphis home and discovered that his wife was missing. The husband, as well as his friends, family and neighbors began to receive ransom calls. FBI agents noticed that one neighbor seemed to have the best rapport with the kidnapper. They began to question his level of involvement, but had to proceed carefully, knowing that he could be their only link to the missing woman.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: On October 2, 1987, a Boston police officer responding to a domestic disturbance call was fatally wounded. Local authorities launched a citywide manhunt, but were only able to find the fingerprints of the chief suspect. Believing that he had fled the area, the FBI followed the suspect's trail to the west coast and then across the Mexican border, always aware of the desperation of a cop killer and of the need for justice.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In August 1984, the son of a successful real estate developer was kidnapped in front of his father's business in Miami. After the father received a $3 million ransom demand from a self-proclaimed terrorist, the FBI became involved. Based on witness descriptions of the car used in the kidnapping, authorities began to suspect a pair of Colombian nationals with a known grudge against the developer's family.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In October 1995, a South Carolina family was taken hostage as part of an elaborately planned bank robbery. Local police quickly identified two of the perpetrators, but the criminal mastermind proved more elusive. After his escape from custody, authorities began to suspect the fugitive of involvement in a series of bank robberies up and down the east coast, and the FBI remained on his trail, hoping to catch him before he took more hostages.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In February 1988, a record store clerk in Sandusky, Ohio, was fatally shot in his van. After discovering a night deposit bag with thousands of dollars in the vehicle, police knew that robbery was not the motive, and began to investigate other possibilities. FBI agents learned that several motorcycle gang members had been stopped nearby on a traffic violation shortly after the murder and theorized that the clerk's murder may have been a botched hit carried out by a gang member.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In June 1973, a young girl was abducted from a state park on the Missouri River while camping with her family. Several months passed with no leads, then an FBI agent took a particular interest in the case. Using a new technique known as criminal profiling, he predicted that the kidnapper would contact the girl's family on the one-year anniversary of her abduction. When this prediction came true, the FBI agent noted behavioral clues, hoping that they could lead him to the kidnapper.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In 1996, a group of political extremists twice robbed a bank in Spokane, Washington, using homemade bombs and military precision to escape. The FBI learned that the robbers, part of a shadowy organization called the Phineas Priesthood, might be preparing for a small-scale war with law enforcement. After the suspects were identified, the FBI was faced with the task of safely arresting a group of terrorists with a deadly agenda.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In August 1992, a man returned to his Memphis home and discovered that his wife was missing. The husband, as well as his friends, family and neighbors began to receive ransom calls. FBI agents noticed that one neighbor seemed to have the best rapport with the kidnapper. They began to question his level of involvement, but had to proceed carefully, knowing that he could be their only link to the missing woman.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In the Spring of 1997, a killer preying on senior citizens terrorizes the River Parish area of Southern Louisiana. By May, local police and the New Orleans FBI are exploring a connection between the April 9 murder of a 71-year old widow and the May 9 murder of a retired couple. A month later, authorities forward information on the crimes to the FBI's Behavioral Science Unit in Quantico, VA, hoping a profile will help them narrow the field of possible suspects.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: California Highway Patrolman George Gwaltney discovered the body of 23-year-old Robin Bishop near her car on a remote desert highway. Although he proclaimed his innocence the FBI lab experts were able to link tool marks found on the frame with tools found in Gwaltney's home. Through the match of hairs and fibers and a unique test for detecting and identifying sperm, Gwaltney was placed at the scene of the crime.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In the early 1990's drug gangs terrorized Harlem, New York neighborhoods. When a 10-year-old boy fell victim in the crossfire, NYPD detectives and FBI agents clamped down on the problem. They formed a task force called C-11, designed to dismantle the gangs. In an environment of violence and fear it would be difficult to identify, arrest and convict those involved in the secretive and deadly world of big money drugs.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In Kokomo, Indiana an unthinkable crime terrified residents. A young woman was snatched from her home on a bright spring morning. Drops of blood and a torn window screen were all that was left to tell authorities what happened to the twenty-one year old victim. After several days of searching, a former FBI profiler narrowed the suspect list to one. Agents and detectives followed the trail across state lines hoping to find the victim before her time ran out.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: When violent criminals strike, the FBI strikes back, employing every available resource, and creating new ones when necessary. From forensic science to criminal profiling, specialized intelligence to global fugitive tracking, the agents of the FBI battle the bad guys with a most powerful arsenal: the crime-fighter's toolbox. This special episode of The FBI Files celebrates the groundbreaking science, investigative technique, and gut-level instinct that has made the FBI the world's premier law enforcement agency.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: After a series of brutal bank robberies and murders in south Miami during the mid-1980's, the FBI embarked on an exhaustive eight-month investigation. With little evidence and no suspects, agents were willing to try anything to find the violent perpetrators. On April 11, 1986, agents conducting routine surveillance spotted the vehicle used in the bank robberies. They attempted to arrest the two suspects in the car. What followed was the bloodiest firefight in FBI history.

400000091.title: The FBI Files

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In 1990 and 1991, Chicago police and the FBI were on the trail of a bank robber whose holdups were becoming increasingly violent. The criminal consistently used stolen Japanese cars to carry out the robberies, so authorities hoped to identify him by tracking vehicle thefts. When they finally located the man known as the bearded bandit, they learned that he did not work alone and he had made a pact never to surrender.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In 1988, new light was shed on the mysterious death of a South Carolina farmer when a criminal confessed that two prominent community members hired him to commit murder. Local police and FBI agents arrested a wealthy businessman and later learned that, even behind bars, he commanded the power to corrupt and kill. Using prison informants, agents had to prevent him from murdering again.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In January 1984, a U.S. Customs official disappears from his post near the Del Rio, Texas border crossing, prompting local police to search for four Latin American suspects driving a Pontiac Grand Prix. The following day, the Customs official was found dead. Two state troopers recovered the missing officer's service revolver after a fatal altercation with two men. Local police and the FBI continued searching for the suspect vehicle, prepared for a confrontation with desperate criminals.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: Amid the cocaine wars of early 1980's Miami, three dead bodies led a multi-agency tactical squad to suspect that a group of cops might be involved in illegal drug busts. Investigating rumors of corruption, the squad uncovered a ring of patrolmen who were making millions by ripping off smuggled cocaine. The investigators set out to prove that even with the advantages wealth and the protection of a police badge, nobody is above the law.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: At 9:30 am on the morning of January 30, 1997, Richmond, VA police respond to a report of shots fired at a local bank. Two masked men brandishing automatic weapons confront, and open fire on officers responding to the call. The gunmen exit the bank, and retreat on foot, eventually eluding the officers. The FBI soon responds, only to find one bank teller dead, another wounded, and the bank's security guard shot four times, yet still alive.
