turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Locket
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Flashbacks show why a psychiatrist (Brian Aherne) warned a man not to marry his ex-wife (Laraine Day). (Drama) - 1946

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Woman on Pier 13
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Communists blackmail a San Francisco shipper (Robert Ryan) and recruit his wife's (Laraine Day) brother (John Agar) with a blonde. (Crime drama) - 1950

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: MGM Parade Show
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: The concept allows the viewer to see the inner workings of a movie studio and featured interviews with MGM stars and explanations of how movies were made; the format changed to show edited versions of MGM films. (Special, Drama) - 2005-12-09

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: All That Heaven Allows
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Predicated on a May-December romance. The difference here is that the woman, attractive widow Cary Scott (Jane Wyman), is considerably older than the man, handsome gardener-landscaper Ron Kirby (Rock Hudson). Throwing conventional behavior to the winds and facing social ostracism, Cary pursues her romance with Ron, who is unjustly perceived as a fortune-hunter by Cary's friends and family -- especially her priggish brother Ned (William Reynolds). (Romance) - 1955

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Leave Her to Heaven
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: While on a train, writer Richard Harland (Cornel Wilde) strikes up a relationship with the gorgeous Ellen Berent (Gene Tierney). Ellen quickly becomes obsessed with Richard and abandons her fiancé, Russell Quinton (Vincent Price), to be with him. The couple rushes into marriage, with both of them caught up in romance and Richard intrigued by Ellen's intensity. Only after settling into marriage, however, does Richard realize that she is psychotically jealous and highly unstable. (Crime drama) - 1945

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Trouble With Harry
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: When a local man's corpse appears on a nearby hillside, no one is quite sure what happened to him. Many of the town's residents secretly wonder if they are responsible, including the man's ex-wife, Jennifer (Shirley MacLaine), and Capt. Albert Wiles (Edmund Gwenn), a retired seaman who was hunting in the woods where the body was found. As the no-nonsense sheriff (Royal Dano) gets involved and local artist Sam Marlowe (John Forsythe) offers his help, the community slowly unravels the mystery. (Comedy) - 1955

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Cobweb
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: At a psychiatric clinic for the elite, Dr. Stewart McIver (Richard Widmark) wants to institute a policy of self-governance among his patients. To further his goals, Dr. McIver proposes that residents collaborate to design and make new drapes for the clinic library. Though it seems inconsequential, trouble ensues when the clinic patients become locked in a power struggle with the equally unbalanced staff, including activities director Meg Rinehart (Lauren Bacall). (Drama) - 1955

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Daytrippers
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Eliza D'Amico's seemingly idyllic marriage to Louis changes dramatically when she discovers what she believes to be a love letter to him from someone else. Going home to her family for comfort, Eliza sets out with her mother, father, sister and her sister's boyfriend in the family car to track down and confront Louis. Always one step behind him, the family learns a lot about each other in the process. (Comedy) - 1996

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Sweet November
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Sara (Sandy Dennis), a free-spirited single woman living in Brooklyn, invites a new man to stay with her every month. For Sara, this is an opportunity to expose a man to new things, but it's also a way to make sure she will always be remembered by someone. Her latest boarder is Charlie (Anthony Newley), an uptight British businessman. Things, however, don't go as planned, and the two fall in love. Despite this, Charlie cannot stay any longer than his allotted month. (Comedy drama) - 1968

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Outward Bound
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A group of strangers finds themselves aboard an unmanned ship, surrounded by fog and uncertain of their destination. As they attempt to make sense of their situation, the group of passengers, which include a man (Leslie Howard) and his long-lost mother (Beryl Mercer), discover that all they have in common is that each is dead and en route to their final judgment by Thompson (Dudley Digges). However, two desperate lovers, Henry (Douglas Fairbanks Jr.) and Ann (Helen Chandler), may be different. (Drama) - 1930

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Smilin' Through
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: On the day of his wedding, Sir John Carteret's fiancée, Moonyeen, is killed by a jealous rival named Jeremy, leaving him emotionally devastated. Carteret spends three decades in seclusion, mostly communing with the spirit of Moonyeen, until he learns that her niece, Kathleen (also Shearer), has become an orphan. He adopts and raises the child as his own but is alarmed when, as a young woman, she falls in love with the son of Moonyeen's murderer. (Romance) - 1932

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Romeo and Juliet
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: In this classic Hollywood take on Shakespeare's tragic romance, dashing young Romeo (Leslie Howard), a Montague, falls in love with the radiant Juliet (Norma Shearer), a member of the Capulet family, the Montagues' sworn enemies. Willing to defy the families' feud, the two secretly get married, however their happy day turns tragic when Juliet's cousin, Tybalt (Basil Rathbone) kills Romeo's best friend, Mercutio (John Barrymore), prompting Romeo to retaliate. (Romance) - 1936

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Petrified Forest
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: In this film adaptation of the Robert E. Sherwood play, a drifter, a waitress and a notorious gangster cross paths in the Petrified Forest region of Arizona. Alan (Leslie Howard), a destitute writer, goes into the diner where Gabrielle (Bette Davis) works. Gabrielle dreams of studying art, and she and Alan connect as they talk about Europe, and she tells him her ambitions. But gangster Duke Mantee (Humphrey Bogart) shows up and takes the customers hostage. (Drama) - 1936

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: It's Love I'm After
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Despite constant bickering on and offstage, Shakespearean actors Basil Underwood (Leslie Howard) and Joyce Arden (Bette Davis) intend to marry after their closing performance in "Romeo and Juliet." But following the show, debutante Marcia West (Olivia de Havilland), smitten by Basil's interpretation of Romeo, visits backstage to declare him the perfect man for her. Basil is initially flattered by her attentions, which enrages Joyce -- until they both find Marcia more than they can handle. (Comedy) - 1937

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Pygmalion
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: When linguistics professor Henry Higgins (Leslie Howard) boasts that he can pass off Cockney flower girl Eliza Doolittle (Wendy Hiller) as a princess with only six months' training, Colonel George Pickering (Scott Sunderland) takes him up on the bet. Eliza moves into Higgins's home and begins her rigorous training after the professor comes to a financial agreement with her dustman father, Alfred (Wilfrid Lawson). But the plucky young woman is not the only one undergoing a transformation. (Romantic comedy) - 1938

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: 49th Parallel
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: In the early days of World War II, a German U-boat is sunk in Canada's Hudson Bay. Hoping to evade capture, a small band of German soldiers led by commanding officer Lieutenant Hirth (Eric Portman) attempts to cross the border into the United States, which has not yet entered the war and is officially neutral. Along the way, the German soldiers encounter brave men such as French-Canadian fur trapper Johnnie (Laurence Olivier) and soldier Andy Brock (Raymond Massey). (Thriller) - 1941

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Monty Python and the Holy Grail
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A comedic send-up of the grim circumstances of the Middle Ages as told through the story of King Arthur and framed by a modern-day murder investigation. When the mythical king of the Britons leads his knights on a quest for the Holy Grail, they face a wide array of horrors, including a persistent Black Knight, a three-headed giant, a cadre of shrubbery-challenged knights, the perilous Castle Anthrax, a killer rabbit, a house of virgins, and a handful of rude Frenchmen. (Comedy) - 1975

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Monty Python's Life of Brian
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Brian Cohen (Graham Chapman) is an average young Jewish man, but through a series of ridiculous events, he gains a reputation as the Messiah. When he's not dodging his followers or being scolded by his shrill mother (Terry Jones), the hapless Brian has to contend with the pompous Pontius Pilate (Michael Palin) and acronym-obsessed members of a separatist movement. Rife with Monty Python's signature absurdity, the tale finds Brian's life paralleling Biblical lore, albeit with many more laughs. (Comedy) - 1979

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Monty Python's The Meaning of Life
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: The stages of life are told through multiple sketches and songs by the British comedy troupe. The seven parts of life cover birth, growing up, war, middle age, organ transplants, old age and death. Not all stages are singular: "Part I: The Miracle of Birth" is from the perspective of an ignored woman in labor, and of a Roman Catholic couple with too many children, and "Part VII: Death" encompasses a funeral and heaven. Added are three unrelated skits placed in the beginning, middle and end. (Comedy) - 1983

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Yentl
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Rebbe Mendel is a single father who teaches the Talmud, a sacred text of Judaism, to the boys of his small Polish town. Behind closed doors, he also instructs his daughter, Yentl, despite the fact that girls are forbidden to study religious scripture. When Yentl's father dies, she still has a strong desire to learn about her faith -- so she disguises herself as a male, enrolls in a religious school, and unexpectedly finds love along the way. (Musical, Drama, Romance) - 1983

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: What's Up, Doc?
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Two researchers have come to San Francisco to compete for a research grant in music. The man seems a bit distracted, and that was before he met a strange woman who has devoted her life to confusing and embarrassing him. At the same time a woman has her jewels stolen, and a government whistleblower arrives with his stolen top secret papers. (Comedy) - 1972

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Elmer the Great
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Elmer Kane (Joe E. Brown) is an arrogant but gullible baseball player who must leave his Gentryville sweetheart, Nellie (Patricia Ellis), to join the Chicago Cubs. Once on board, his teammates take advantage of his gullibility with practical jokes, and the management hides the letters that come from Nellie. When she comes to Chicago to see him play the World Series, a series of misunderstandings and bad judgments threatens to ruin both his love life and career. (Comedy) - 1933

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Random Harvest
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A veteran of World War I, Charles Rainier (Ronald Colman) has lost all memory of his life before the war. Left to wander, Rainier meets a showgirl, Paula (Greer Garson), with whom he falls in love. Rainier and Paula are soon happily married, but when Rainier travels out of town, a car hits him -- erasing the memories of his life with Paula, but restoring those of his life before the war. While he returns to his previous life, Paula tries to find a way to be reunited with her husband. (Drama) - 1942

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Anthony Adverse
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Based on the novel by Hervey Allen, this expansive drama follows the many adventures of the eponymous hero (Fredric March). Abandoned at a convent by his heartless nobleman father, Don Luis (Claude Rains), Anthony is later mentored by his kind grandfather, John Bonnyfeather (Edmund Gwenn), and falls for the beautiful Angela Giuseppe (Olivia de Havilland). When circumstances separate Anthony and Angela, and he embarks on a long journey, he must find his way back to her, no matter what the cost. (Romance) - 1936

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: They Won't Forget
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: The town of Flodden is in an uproar when a pretty student is found dead on Confederate Memorial Day, but District Attorney Griffin (Claude Rains) sees it as an opportunity. Thinking the case could propel him into the U.S. Senate, he begins an extensive smear campaign against the girl's teacher, Robert Hale (Edward Norris), an outsider who hails from New York. Despite only circumstantial evidence, Hale is convicted, and locals threaten vigilante justice if he isn't executed. (Drama) - 1937

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: I Am a Fugitive From a Chain Gang
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Jaded World War I veteran James Allen (Paul Muni) dreams of creating a new life, but those dreams are shattered when he is implicated in a robbery and sentenced to 10 years on a chain gang. The brutal prison conditions compel James to break out and flee to Chicago, where he assumes a new identity and, over time, becomes a successful businessman. His freedom and happiness are threatened, however, when his scheming landlady (Glenda Farrell) discovers his secret and threatens to blackmail him. (Docudrama) - 1932

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Little Caesar
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: An aspiring small-town criminal, Caesar "Rico" Bandello (Edward G. Robinson) relocates to Chicago to hit the big time, accompanied by his buddy, Joe Massara (Douglas Fairbanks Jr.). While Rico makes a name for himself in the underworld, Joe decides to leave the life of crime and ventures into show business, where he meets the lovely dancer Olga (Glenda Farrell). Though Rico and Joe try to honor their friendship, eventually their choices take them down dramatically different paths. (Crime drama) - 1930

SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S9 E7 Episode 7 Laura starts her day making her Bircher Muesli with a twist, before her Italian heritage comes out with a delicious Creamy Roasted Capsicum Pasta.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: The Cook Up With Adam Liaw
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S8 E69 Special Treats Two very special guests, comedian Alex Ward and dessert legend Adriano Zumbo, join Adam in the kitchen for a night full of very special treats.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Jamie At Home
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E1 Lamb Jamie gets a visit from Daphne, a Welsh sheep farmer, and they talk about some of the misconceptions of spring lamb, the differences between lamb, hogget and mutton and animal's good conditions.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Lidia's Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S8 E8 Wheat Harvest And Pasta Lidia talks the hard work involved with making flour, then bread and pasta. She makes croutons with a Caesar salad, then a fusilli with spinach and herbed ricotta, and a lagane pasta with chickpeas.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Pati's Mexican Table
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S13 E8 Chihuahua's Cheesiest Cheese Pati explores the culture of the mysterious Mennonites, a religious community who came to Chihuahua from Germany.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Mark Moriarty: Off Duty Chef
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E8 Dining In Chef Mark loves throwing a dinner party for his friends and family. He's reviving the classic prawn cocktail, then an epic beef wellington, and lastly a trick to a make a creme caramel.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Lorraine Pascale: Be A Better Cook
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E5 Travis Francis Lorraine Pascale creates a menu inspired by a student's Caribbean roots.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Food Tales
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E1 A Chilli Love Story Noorman and Puti are a husband-and-wife duo who founded Nasi Lemak Ayam Taliwang, which combines the Singaporean Malay dish Nasi Lemak from Noorman's heritage, and the Indonesian dish Ayam Taliwang.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Kriol Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E10 Broome: Pat Torres Gubinge Jam with Bush Fig & Bush Fig Cup Cakes with a Bush Passion Fruit Icing: Ali & Mitch join their cousin Pat to learn how to whip up some sweet treats using local bush fruits found in the region.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: People Of The North
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S3 E7 Aukra / Ona: Island Traditions and Innovation Exploring local delicacies, alternative farm schools and entrepreneurs making flake salt from ocean water on the rugged islands of Aukra and Ona; a gas processing plant that powers the U.K.; a modern salmon processing plant.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: My Market Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S8 E13 Episode 13 Back in the market, Laura is joined by dietitian Simone Austin to prepare the ever-popular Bruschetta.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Rachael Ray In Tuscany
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E13 International Pub Cheese Burger Rachael takes the traditional beef burgers to the next level by adding homemade pub cheese topping, sauteed sweet onions, jalapeno peppers, and bacon on a pretzel bun, sealed with lettuce.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Taste Of Australia With Hayden Quinn
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S6 E7 Cobden Hayden is heading to the heart of Australia's dairy country to see a dairy farm and butter factory in action, but first, we're at the iconic 12 Apostles for a start to the day we'll never forget.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Everyday Gourmet: Sweet Edition
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S3 E3 Episode 3 We are serving up pure comfort today.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: My Market Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S9 E8 Episode 8 Laura makes Sushi accessible to the home cook before she heads to the famous wine region of the Barossa Valley and makes an Asian-inspired Chicken Noodle Stir Fry.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Rick Stein's Food Heroes
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E6 Episode 6 Rick is on home turf when he visits the Tintagel area in Cornwall. Here, legend has it, the ruined castle atop the craggy, untamed cliffs is what remains of King Arthur's Camelot.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Everyday Gourmet With Justine Schofield
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S9 E37 Episode 37 Guest Sashi joins Justine on today's episode of Everyday Gourmet where she shares her Spiced Lamb Wrap recipe. Later, Justine makes a Tuna and Fennel Polpette and some Olive Oil Fried Potatoes.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: The Cook Up With Adam Liaw
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S8 E70 Pickles The one and only Peter Kuruvita and the one and only Dave Hughes make a dill with Adam tonight, they're all going to cook with pickles.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Rick Stein's Food Heroes
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E10 North Scotland Rick and Chalky round off their journey of the UK at John O'Groats, visiting Rick's favourite deli in Edinburgh, a fish smokery in Argyll, enjoying freshly cooked lobster on Crail harbour front.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Nigella Express
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E6 Get Up And Go Kickstart the day with unbeatable fast and fabulous breakfasts. From weekend parties to pancake feasts, working breakfasts, solo comforts and wake up shakes, Nigella's got mornings covered.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Lidia's Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S8 E9 Cooking With The Nuns Lidia went to school near Trieste and picked up many essential kitchen skills. Inspired by the soups in school lunches, she makes cannellini bean and lentil soup, and a one pot of sausages and apples.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Pati's Mexican Table
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S13 E9 Hidden Guachochi Pati has a traditional meal with Raramuri community leaders and visits a sustainable ranch.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Mark Moriarty: Off Duty Chef
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E1 Menu One Chef Mark focuses on some classics - spaghetti carbonara using a few cupboard ingredients and a carrot cake. In his 'How To Perfect' series, Mark looks at some essential knife skills to up your game.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Lorraine Pascale: Be A Better Cook
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E6 Sally Mack With plenty of deceptively easy recipes and fantastic tips, Lorraine Pascale shows people with no kitchen confidence how to pull off an impressive meal for friends and family.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Food Tales
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E2 Crazy For Kueh Sandy and Elizabeth are a mother-daughter duo who founded Kueh Ho Jiak, which keeps the heritage of kueh (traditional Asian confectionery) and kueh-making alive.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Kriol Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E1 Ali & Mitch Torres: Stinky Pearl Shell & Garlic Butter Pearl Meat Ali and Mitch share two recipes they grew up with that their father used to make - a condiment made from the intestines of the pearl shell and also a dish made from the muscle of the shell.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: People Of The North
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S3 E8 Austevoll / Barentshavet: Snow Crab In Arctic Waters Take an unforgettable adventure to Austevoll and the Barents Sea, where coastal culture, sustainable fishing and local history come to life.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: My Market Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S8 E14 Episode 14 Chef Mod joins Laura in the market to cook his wonderful Thai Beef Salad. Up next, farmer Catherine Velisha and chef Charlie Carrington have some fun with Charlie's dish, Cucumber and Prawn Tacos.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Rachael Ray In Tuscany
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E14 Rabbit Ragu Rachael teaches how to prepare rabbit ragu, a traditional Tuscan recipe that combines ground rabbit, vegetables, wine, and more to make a thick sauce served over long pasta.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Taste Of Australia With Hayden Quinn
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S6 E8 Port Douglas From rural Victoria to Tropical North Queensland - it doesn't get much better! Hayden heads back to Queensland for the Taste Port Douglas food festival.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Everyday Gourmet: Sweet Edition
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S3 E4 Episode 4 Josep Espuga makes his famous caramelized Burnt Basque Cheesecake.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: My Market Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S9 E9 Episode 9 There's a hint of Korea in the Prahran Market as Laura prepares her take on a Beef Bibimbap with Gochujang Sauce.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Rick Stein's Food Heroes
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E7 Episode 7 In the Clovelly area of North Devon, Rick goes fishing for herring with Steve Perham, whose family have been fishermen for over 200 years.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Everyday Gourmet With Justine Schofield
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S9 E38 Episode 38 Everyday Gourmet takes your tastebuds on an adventure on today's episode where they show you recipes from Petit Sale Pork and Lentils to Sardine Escabeche to Portugese Rice Pudding.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: The Cook Up With Adam Liaw
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S8 E71 A Meal To Remember It's an unforgettable night on The Cook Up, as Adam and his guests, chefs Stephannie Liu and Brian Cole, each make a meal to remember!

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Outback Gourmet With Justine Schofield
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E1 Episode 1 Justine travels from Darwin to Kakadu exploring the Ubirri Rock Art walk, where she prepares a picnic lunch by the stunning Maguk Pools and experiences a pop up dining experience like no other.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: A Girl's Guide to Hunting, Fishing and Wild Cooking
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E1 Episode 1 Analiese starts her first Tasmanian Spring with a 'Welcome to Country' ceremony. She learns to shoot and goes on an overnight fishing adventure before laying down roots in her new native garden.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Paddock To Plate
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E5 Gascoyne, WA Matt Moran visits Western Australia's Gascoyne Region and prepares dishes inspired by local bananas, avocadoes, crab and Pink Snapper.

syfy.us.description: After carefree teenager Jay (Maika Monroe) sleeps with her new boyfriend, Hugh (Jake Weary), for the first time, she learns that she is the latest recipient of a fatal curse that is passed from victim to victim via sexual intercourse. Death, Jay learns, will creep inexorably toward her as either a friend or a stranger. Jay's friends don't believe her seemingly paranoid ravings, until they too begin to see the phantom assassins and band together to help her flee or defend herself. (Horror, Thriller) - 2014

syfy.us.title: The Exorcist: Believer
syfy.us.description: When his daughter, Angela, and her friend Katherine, show signs of demonic possession, it unleashes a chain of events that forces single father Victor Fielding to confront the nadir of evil. Terrified and desperate, he seeks out Chris MacNeil, the only person alive who's witnessed anything like it before. (Horror) - 2023

syfy.us.title: The Boogeyman
syfy.us.description: High school student Sadie Harper and her younger sister, Sawyer, are still reeling from the recent death of their mother. They're not getting much support from their father, Will, a therapist who's dealing with his own intense pain. When a desperate patient unexpectedly shows up at their house seeking help, he leaves behind a terrifying supernatural entity that preys on families and feeds on the suffering of its victims. (Horror, Thriller) - 2023

syfy.us.title: Halloween
syfy.us.description: It's been 40 years since Laurie Strode survived a vicious attack from crazed killer Michael Myers on Halloween night. Locked up in an institution, Myers manages to escape when his bus transfer goes horribly wrong. Laurie now faces a terrifying showdown when the masked madman returns to Haddonfield, Ill. -- but this time, she's ready for him. (Holiday, Horror, Thriller) - 2018

Anchor Clinton Griffiths leads the show's on-air team. (News, Agriculture)

fxm.us.title: The Last Duel
fxm.us.description: Jean de Carrouges is a respected knight known for his bravery and skill on the battlefield. Jacques Le Gris is a squire whose intelligence and eloquence makes him one of the most admired nobles in court. When Le Gris viciously assaults Carrouges' wife, she steps forward to accuse her attacker, an act of bravery and defiance that puts her life in jeopardy. The ensuing trial by combat, a grueling duel to the death, places the fate of all three in God's hands. (Historical drama) - 2021

fxm.us.title: The Banshees of Inisherin
fxm.us.description: On a remote island off the coast of Ireland, Pádraic is devastated when his buddy Colm suddenly puts an end to their lifelong friendship. With help from his sister and a troubled young islander, Pádraic sets out to repair the damaged relationship by any means necessary. However, as Colm's resolve only strengthens, he soon delivers an ultimatum that leads to shocking consequences. (Dark comedy) - 2022

fxm.us.title: Death on the Nile
fxm.us.description: Belgian sleuth Hercule Poirot's Egyptian vacation aboard a glamorous river steamer turns into a terrifying search for a murderer when a picture-perfect couple's idyllic honeymoon is tragically cut short. (Mystery, Thriller, Crime drama) - 2022

fxm.us.title: Freud's Last Session
fxm.us.description: On the eve of World War II, Sigmund Freud and C.S. Lewis gather to discuss the existence of God and the future of mankind. (Drama) - 2023

fxm.us.title: Let's Make Love
fxm.us.description: One of the wealthiest men in the world, Jean-Marc Clement (Yves Montand) is rich in money, but lacking in love. While seeking someone who adores him for his personality rather than his fortune, Clement learns that he is the subject of a satirical theater production. Unrecognized as he visits the play's set, Clement is offered the part as himself by the show's unwitting producers, and he takes the gig to be close to the gorgeous yet down-to-earth actress Amanda Dell (Marilyn Monroe). (Musical comedy) - 1960

fxm.us.title: High Anxiety
fxm.us.description: Just after becoming the director of the Psychoneurotic Institute for the Very, Very Nervous, Dr. Richard H. Thorndyke is greeted by a series of mysterious events. When his colleagues -- including the militaristic and mustachioed Nurse Diesel -- become leery of his questions, they accuse him of murder. Thorndyke's own mental health comes into question as he struggles to clear his name in the midst of a crippling bout of a condition known as high anxiety. (Comedy) - 1977

fxm.us.title: The Detective
fxm.us.description: When a gay man is viciously slain, Detective Joe Leland (Frank Sinatra) is put on the case. Joe eventually tracks down the victim's roommate, who confesses to the crime and is sentenced to death; however, the outcome of the case doesn't sit well with the detective. Norma (Jacqueline Bisset), a distraught widow, visits Joe. She believes her husband's death was no accident, but the cops don't seem to care. Joe begins to investigate, and stumbles on a cover-up related to his previous case. (Crime drama, LGBTQ) - 1968

fxm.us.title: The French Connection
fxm.us.description: New York Detective Popeye Doyle (Gene Hackman) and his partner (Roy Scheider) chase a French heroin smuggler. (Crime drama, Thriller) - 1971

fxm.us.title: Eyewitness
fxm.us.description: New York City custodian Daryll Deever (William Hurt) is a big fan of local news reporter Tony Sokolow (Sigourney Weaver), so he is intrigued when she shows up to cover a story at his workplace. There's been a murder in the office building, and Tony suspects that Daryll may have insight into the crime, a notion that he furthers to stay close to her. However, when those behind the killing begin to think that Daryll really knows something, they target both him and Tony to keep their secrets hidden. (Thriller) - 1981

fxm.us.title: Alien
fxm.us.description: In deep space, the crew of the commercial starship Nostromo is awakened from their cryo-sleep capsules halfway through their journey home to investigate a distress call from an alien vessel. The terror begins when the crew encounters a nest of eggs inside the alien ship. An organism from inside an egg leaps out and attaches itself to one of the crew, causing him to fall into a coma. (Science fiction, Horror) - 1979

fxm.us.title: Alien: Romulus
fxm.us.description: Space colonizers come face to face with the most terrifying life-form in the universe while scavenging the deep ends of a derelict space station. (Science fiction, Horror) - 2024

fxm.us.title: Aliens
fxm.us.description: After floating in space for 57 years, Lt. Ripley's shuttle is found by a deep space salvage team. Upon arriving at LV-426, the marines find only one survivor, a nine-year-old girl named Newt. But even these battle-hardened marines with all the latest weaponry are no match for the hundreds of aliens that have invaded the colony. (Science fiction, Horror, Action, Adventure) - 1986

fxm.us.title: Alien 3
fxm.us.description: Ellen Ripley (Sigourney Weaver) is the only survivor when she crash lands on Fiorina 161, a bleak wasteland inhabited by former inmates of the planet's maximum security prison. Once again, Ripley must face skepticism and the alien as it hunts down the prisoners and guards. Without weapons or modern technology of any kind, Ripley leads the men into battle against the terrifying creature. (Science fiction, Horror) - 1992

fxm.us.title: Alien Resurrection
fxm.us.description: Two hundred years have passed since Ellen Ripley died on Fiorina 161. Aboard the medical research vessel USM Auriga, a team of scientists clones Ripley from her extracted DNA and removes the alien Queen embryo which was growing inside her at the time of her death. (Science fiction, Horror) - 1997

While both Willis and his Drac counterpart can breathe on the planet, the environment and its creatures are relatively hostile, forcing the two to work together to survive. As time goes by, Willis and Jeriba become unlikely friends, though their unique relationship faces considerable challenges. (Science fiction) - 1985

fxm.us.title: The Earth Dies Screaming
fxm.us.description: An astronaut (Willard Parker) returns from a test flight to find England overtaken by alien-controlled robots which turn corpses into zombies. (Science fiction) - 1964

fxm.us.title: The Alligator People
fxm.us.description: Newly married nurse Joyce Webster (Beverly Garland) doesn't know what to think when her husband, Paul (Richard Crane), disappears during a train ride. She hires private investigators and eventually tracks him to an old bayou plantation, where the owner (Frieda Inescort) insists she's never heard of Paul. Joyce sticks around anyway and soon learns that local doctor Mark Sinclair (George Macready) has been using a life-altering alligator serum on the town's residents, and that Paul is among them. (Horror) - 1959

fxm.us.title: The Fly
fxm.us.description: When scientist Andre Delambre (Al Hedison) tests his matter transporter on himself, an errant housefly makes its way into the transportation chamber, and things go horribly wrong. As a result, Delambre's head and arm are now that of the insect. Slowly losing himself to the fly, Delambre turns to his wife, Helene (Patricia Owens), for help. But when tragedy strikes, Delambre's brother (Vincent Price) and Inspector Charas (Herbert Marshall) are forced to pick up the investigation. (Horror, Science fiction) - 1958

fxm.us.title: The Curse of the Fly
fxm.us.description: Scantily clad Patricia Stanley (Carole Gray) breaks out of a mental hospital and is picked up by passing motorist Martin Delambre (George Baker). The two do not reveal much about themselves to each other, but nevertheless decide to get married. At the Delambre family mansion, Patricia meets Martin's father, Henri (Brian Donlevy), an eccentric scientist. Snooping about the grounds, she discovers evidence of the family's strange experiments in teleportation and the grisly results thereof. (Horror, Science fiction, Mystery, Drama) - 1965

fxm.us.title: The Horror of It All
fxm.us.description: Yankee salesman Jack (Pat Boone) wants to marry Cynthia Marley (Erica Rogers), and they travel to her family's English estate to break the good news. Cynthia warns that the family is a bit odd, which proves to be an understatement. One relative is an ex-thespian who still believes he's in a play, another behaves like a vampire and a third is imprisoned in the cellar due to his violent tendencies. But things get really sinister when the Marleys start succumbing to violent fates, one by one. (Horror) - 1964

fxm.us.title: Witchcraft
fxm.us.description: For generations, the Whitlocks and the Laniers have been feuding, including when Vanessa Whitlock (Yvette Rees), accused of being a witch, was buried alive centuries ago. Now Bill Lanier (Jack Hedley) wants to dig up a burial ground for development purposes, and Morgan Whitlock (Lon Chaney Jr.) tries to stop him. Soon, unexplainable accidents start to happen to members of the Lanier family, throwing suspicion on Morgan. The real truth Bill discovers is much more sinister than he expected. (Horror) - 1964

bbcamerica.us.description: Repairmen Val McKee (Kevin Bacon) and Earl Bassett (Fred Ward) are tired of their dull lives in the small desert town of Perfection, Nev. But just as the two try to skip town, they happen upon a series of mysterious deaths and a concerned seismologist (Finn Carter) studying unnatural readings below the ground. With the help of an eccentric couple (Reba McEntire, Michael Gross), the group fights for survival against giant, worm-like monsters hungry for human flesh. (Horror, Comedy) - 1990

With the help of his new friend, Willard Hewitt (Christopher Penn), and defiant teen Ariel Moore (Lori Singer), he might loosen up this conservative town. An employee of the Dukes, Winthorpe is framed by the brothers for a crime he didn't commit, with the siblings then installing the street-smart Valentine in his position. When Winthorpe and Valentine uncover the scheme, they set out to turn the tables on the Dukes. (Comedy) - 1983

buzzr.us.title: The Price Is Right
buzzr.us.description: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." That's repeated in the second half of the show, and two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. Models present the prizes. (Game show) - 1972-09-04

buzzr.us.title: The Price Is Right
buzzr.us.description: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." That's repeated in the second half of the show, and two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. Models present the prizes. (Game show) - 1972-09-04

hgtvwest.us.title: 100 Day Dream Home
hgtvwest.us.description: S07 E12 Can't Contain Myself Brian and Mika take on the task of building their first container home.

hgtvwest.us.title: House Shock
hgtvwest.us.description: S01 E04 Surprising Their Parents A brother and sister look to give their parents the ultimate thank you by surprising them with a dream renovation. With the help of Arielle and Steve, they aim to transform the family room into a cozy retreat while honoring their Indian heritage.

hgtvwest.us.title: House Hunters International
hgtvwest.us.description: S211 E03 Leaving Big Pharma for Tulum, Mexico Overburdened by a career in big pharma, a German woman decided to leave it all to travel the world and fell in love with Tulum, Mexico. She's looking to purchase her first home, but her extensive wish list may not match her budget.

hgtvwest.us.title: House Hunters International
hgtvwest.us.description: S209 E08 From Zambia to Phnom Penh City Streets After six years teaching in rural Zambia, a family is ready for their next adventure in Phnom Penh, Cambodia; with new jobs ahead and school starting soon, they're looking for a home that helps their kids adjust to a culture they barely know.

hgtvwest.us.title: House Hunters International
hgtvwest.us.description: S207 E03 London Artist Takes on the Australian Outback A British artist looks to focus on growing her art tour business and permanently relocate to Alice Springs, Australia; she's looking for a big block of land with nature views to run workshops, but it may not match the size of her budget.

hgtvwest.us.title: House Hunters International
hgtvwest.us.description: S200 E06 Big Ben and Big Decisions in London A Seattle family of five looks to relocate for a job opportunity to London; he wants to be close to the action with enough space to entertain, but she's the only one working and prefers an easy commute and a place that's comfortable for the family.

hgtvwest.us.title: Crashers
hgtvwest.us.description: S01 E11 Spa Day Every Day Jon Knight and his team transform a couple's outdated primary suite in just 72 hours; it's a cold, disconnected bedroom and bathroom that feels like a motel, and they're aiming to create a cohesive, spa-like retreat built for rest and connection.

hgtvwest.us.title: Crashers
hgtvwest.us.description: S01 E03 Crooked Kitchen Jon Knight and his team crash Nick and Nia's poorly designed, dysfunctional kitchen, transforming an outdated space that simply doesn't work for their family's needs into a sleek, functional hub where they can finally cook, gather, and connect.

hgtvwest.us.title: Farmhouse Fixer
hgtvwest.us.description: S03 E07 Clam Shack Chic A clam shack once residing on a nearby island was transformed into a home; Jon and Kristina come to the rescue and pull from its seaside history to create a bright space that's perfect for humans and felines alike.

hgtvwest.us.title: Farmhouse Fixer
hgtvwest.us.description: S03 E06 Berry Farm Charm For the first time ever Jon and Kristina renovate a home on a working berry farm; using salvaged pieces found on the farmstead, they design a glass bottle wall, a hanging plant feature, and completely transform the space.

hgtvwest.us.title: Farmhouse Fixer
hgtvwest.us.description: S03 E05 Saved by the Barn Jon and Kristina come to the rescue for a homeowner who is struggling with a post and beam barn; the barn is a party zone and includes a speakeasy, woodworking, a book club, a teen zone and life-size beer pong.

hgtvwest.us.title: A Very Haunted Renovation
hgtvwest.us.description: S01 E03 Enter if You Dare Four designers remain in the competition to bring the once-grand Bihl Manor back to life; split into two teams, they'll revive the haunted halls on the first and second floors, but will the spirits and judges approve?

hgtvwest.us.title: A Very Haunted Renovation
hgtvwest.us.description: S01 E04 A Game of Haunts The four remaining designers split into two teams to transform the attic into both a spooky speakeasy and a gothic game room; but first, a spine-tingling game brings haunted surprises, pushing their nerves and upcycled feature projects to the limit.

hgtvwest.us.title: A Very Haunted Renovation
hgtvwest.us.description: S01 E05 The Exterior Exorcism And then there were three! For the first time, each designer tackles a space of their own as they transform Bihl Manor's neglected exterior. Battling the spirits and the elements, they're aiming to give the grounds a glow-up worthy of the judges.

hgtvwest.us.title: Scariest House in America
hgtvwest.us.description: S03 E02 Horror in the Ominous Ozarks Retta's journey to find scary takes her to the Ominous Ozarks where three homes duke it out for a chance at a $150,000 makeover by designer Alison Victoria! It includes a home of devilish doppelgängers and a ghostly gangster meeting place.

hgtvwest.us.title: Scariest House in America
hgtvwest.us.description: S03 E03 The Eeriest of the East Retta's journey to find scary takes her to the Eerie East where four homes vie for a chance at a $150,000 makeover by designer Alison Victoria! It includes a ghoulish home overrun with ghosts and a Victorian infested with spiders and apparitions.

hgtvwest.us.title: Scariest House in America
hgtvwest.us.description: S03 E04 Scares of the Mysterious Midwest Retta's journey takes her to the Mysterious Midwest where four homes contend for a chance at a $150,000 makeover by designer Alison Victoria! It includes a ghostly home with a history of squatters and a Victorian full of ghosts and dolls.

hgtvwest.us.title: Zillow Gone Wild
hgtvwest.us.description: S03 E01 Back to the Wild Kicking things off at a house with a 727 airplane inside; exploring a pink time capsule-esque penthouse.

hgtvwest.us.title: Zillow Gone Wild
hgtvwest.us.description: S03 E03 Ranch Dressing Jack McBrayer searches for wild homes and goes chugga-chuggin' down to a cozy train caboose hideaway; next, he dreams in color at a pastel-painted ranch and stops by a desert dream oasis; only one home can reign supreme!

hgtvwest.us.title: Zillow Gone Wild
hgtvwest.us.description: S03 E08 Guess Who's Coming to Tour Jack McBrayer's hunt for wild continues as he takes a peekaboo inside a Brooklyn brownstone for sale and gets an update on a previous season's Wild House; later, he travels to Reunion, Florida, to tour a themed home with special guest David Bromstad.

hgtvwest.us.title: Zillow Gone Wild
hgtvwest.us.description: S03 E09 Bubbly Abode Jack continues searching for wild homes; he pops inside a bubble-shaped house with seven domes; visits a stone hall from 1876 that has lived many lives; and climbs high into a towering treehouse created to fulfill a father's childhood dream.

hgtvwest.us.title: Zillow Gone Wild
hgtvwest.us.description: S03 E11 King Pigs and Queen Bees Jack tours a home built as a labor of love and an even larger affection for murals; he also visits a maximalist Victorian mansion that takes visitors on a trip across the globe; later on, he views a dome-shaped home with a special place for bees.

hgtvwest.us.title: Zillow Gone Wild
hgtvwest.us.description: S03 E10 Choose Your Adventure Things take an unusual turn as Jack steps into the '80s and visits a home featured in a popular supernatural show; a homeowner in Denmark shows off his digs, Jack visits a resort with 20 themed dwellings, a spaceship, a castle and a wizard's lair!

hgtvwest.us.title: House Hunters
hgtvwest.us.description: S278 E01 The Devil Wears Modern A cardiologist and mental health therapist couple are miles apart in their N.J. home search; he wants a factory loft while she prefers a suburban sanctuary, and with their budgets a million dollars apart, it may be a battle of style over substance.

hgtvwest.us.title: House Hunters
hgtvwest.us.description: S277 E05 Leaving the Ex at the Old Address A newly engaged couple looks to move out of the home she bought with her ex in Little Rock, Arkansas; she's set on staying in the same neighborhood, but her partner's done living in someone else's past and wants a place that's a fresh start.

hgtvwest.us.title: House Hunters
hgtvwest.us.description: S272 E08 Engineering a New Life A couple decides to buy their first home together in Columbus, Ohio; it's a hot market, and she wants to move fast, but he's an engineer and prefers to take his time to make sure they find the right place.

hgtvwest.us.title: House Hunters
hgtvwest.us.description: S275 E10 Houston, We Have a Problem A couple with three young boys relocates to Houston for his job, and they want to go big; he wants a large, traditional fixer he can renovate to his taste, but she's willing to spend on a fully-updated turnkey house they can move into with ease.

hgtvwest.us.title: House Hunters
hgtvwest.us.description: S279 E11 Rushing Into Things A couple engaged after 44 days looks to buy a beach house for themselves and their two daughters on Florida's Emerald Coast; she has high expectations for luxury living and is willing to pay for it, but he's more frugal and prefers to spend less.

hgtvwest.us.title: House Hunters
hgtvwest.us.description: S269 E10 Shredding for the Wedding Architecture professionals disagree on what kind of home to buy before their wedding in Nashville, Tennessee; she wants a Southern charmer that's historic, but he prefers something modern that's move-in ready.

hgtvwest.us.title: Sin City Rehab ᴺᵉʷ
hgtvwest.us.description: S02 E02 I'm Back to Change the Game Alison challenges her new partner Josh to ditch the cookie-cutter Vegas look and embrace an elevated, custom design; she brings in antique bathroom doors and pushes him to rethink the kitchen's color palette, all in hopes of maximizing their profit.

hgtvwest.us.title: Botched Homes ᴺᵉʷ
hgtvwest.us.description: S01 E07 Rhinestone Throne Charlie and Courtney revive an outdated home with glimpses of mid-century Florida flair. On another project, a seashell-encrusted toilet is the least of Charlie and Courtney's worries about a home with serious moisture issues.

hgtvwest.us.title: House Hunters
hgtvwest.us.description: S261 E08 Georgia Coach Takes One for the Team After landing a college football head coaching job, a couple looks for a new home near campus in Carrollton, Ga.; he's focused on a modern ranch with room to host his players, but she wants a two-story Craftsman that's near the action in Atlanta.

hgtvwest.us.title: House Hunters
hgtvwest.us.description: S276 E02 Queer Eye for the High Rise Opposites attract as an accountant searching for homey vibes clashes with her frugal partner in Chicago; one doesn't want to leave the city's gay district, while the other craves high-rise glam to prove she's made it.

hgtvwest.us.title: House Hunters
hgtvwest.us.description: S278 E03 Something Between a Unicorn and a Fantasy A San Diego couple is searching for a fresh start in New Jersey. He's pushing to buy an older, quirky home beside his aunt and uncle, but she refuses to settle for anything less than her modern fantasy.

hgtvwest.us.title: House Hunters
hgtvwest.us.description: Compromise Is for Quitters A feisty young couple match wits and will as they spar over buying their first home in Dallas; he wants a midcentury with character and doesn't mind projects, but she's after a new-build that's fresh and modern.

hgtvwest.us.title: House Hunters
hgtvwest.us.description: S272 E05 Knack for Drama Sisters with a knack for drama are buying a home together in Augusta, Georgia; their first attempt at living together didn't work out, but with rent sky-high, they're now hoping that a mortgage will force them to work together.

hgtvwest.us.title: House Hunters
hgtvwest.us.description: S271 E39 Abandonment Issues in Phoenix A Phoenix native looks to move back to his hometown to be closer to family. He wants a home that's small and manageable, but his partner in Chicago plans to split his time between the two cities, and he prefers a larger place where he can host.

hgtvwest.us.title: Unsellable Houses
hgtvwest.us.description: S04 E03 Color Confusion to Simple Oasis A homeowner needs help letting go of her colorful home of 25 years; the renovation is a real challenge for Lyndsay and Leslie as they look to transform the color cacophony and convoluted layout into a clean and simple oasis.

hgtvwest.us.title: Unsellable Houses
hgtvwest.us.description: S05 E11 Worst House Gains Big Equity Lyndsay and Leslie help a young couple get a major return on their investment for their new midcentury modern home.

hgtvwest.us.title: Unsellable Houses
hgtvwest.us.description: S05 E02 Five Days to List A widow and her son need help to give their 14-room Victorian farmhouse a more broad appeal. Over the course of only five days, Lyndsay and Leslie transform their uniquely personalized home into a marketable property.

hgtvwest.us.title: Sin City Rehab
hgtvwest.us.description: S02 E01 The Future of Kitchen Design A flashy Vegas realtor has big expectations for a dream kitchen that looks nothing like anything traditional, but when the homeowner's scammed out of his custom cabinets, the entire project nearly falls apart.

hdnetmovies.us.title: Valdez Is Coming
hdnetmovies.us.description: When rancher Frank Tanner (Jon Cypher) hoodwinks local lawman Bob Valdez (Burt Lancaster) into shooting an innocent man, Valdez is remorseful and tries to take up a collection for the widow. Tanner won't hear of it, however, and punishes Valdez by driving him into the desert with a cross strapped to his back. Valdez is freed by one of Tanner's henchmen (Richard Jordan) and, after convalescing, begins waging a one-man war against Tanner, picking off his men with his trusty Sharps rifle. (Western, Drama) - 1971

hdnetmovies.us.title: Convoy
hdnetmovies.us.description: Trucker Martin "Rubber Duck" Penwald (Kris Kristofferson) and his buddies Pig Pen (Burt Young), Widow Woman (Madge Sinclair) and Spider Mike (Franklin Ajaye) use their CB radios to warn one another of the presence of cops. But conniving Sheriff Wallace (Ernest Borgnine) is hip to the truckers' tactics, and begins tricking the drivers through his own CB broadcasts. Facing constant harassment from the law, Rubber Duck and his pals use their radios to coordinate a vast convoy and rule the road. (Action, Drama) - 1978

hdnetmovies.us.title: Death Race 2000
hdnetmovies.us.description: In the year 2000, America is a totalitarian regime on the brink of collapse. The most popular sport in this dystopia is the Transcontinental Road Race, where teams earn points for logging the fastest time and for mowing over the most innocent pedestrians in the process. This year's competitors include Frankenstein (David Carradine), who is rumored to be more machine than man, and the tough-as-nails "Machine Gun" Joe Viterbo (Sylvester Stallone). Some have a plan to stop the race. (Action, Comedy) - 1975

hdnetmovies.us.title: A Reason to Live, A Reason to Die
hdnetmovies.us.description: After surrendering Fort Holman to the Confederacy without there being a single shot fired, Col. Pembroke (James Coburn) faces public disgrace and a potential court-martial unless he's able to recapture the fort now held by the power-mad Maj. Ward (Telly Savalas). To help him on this mission, Pembroke enlists a ragtag bunch of condemned men who are promised their freedom should they survive. Despite much internal strife, the group gradually comes together in time for the assault. (Western) - 1974

hdnetmovies.us.title: Support Your Local Sheriff
hdnetmovies.us.description: A small-scale gold rush erupts in a Colorado town after treasure is found in a grave. The area quickly becomes a magnet for criminals and other ne'er-do-wells, but everyone is too intent on searching for gold to consider law and order. When Jason McCullough (James Garner), a clever and supremely laid-back gunslinger, wanders into town, he becomes the de facto lawman, aided by local eccentric Jake (Jack Elam). McCullough's ingenuity is tested, however, when he runs afoul of the tough Danby gang. (Western, Comedy) - 1969

hdnetmovies.us.title: Support Your Local Gunfighter
hdnetmovies.us.description: When traveling con man Latigo Smith (James Garner) drifts into a small Western town, he decides to take advantage of a local rivalry between gold-mining factions. Recruiting the shifty Jug May (Jack Elam) to pose as a notorious gunfighter, Smith sets his scheme in motion, while also taking time to romance the lovely Patience Barton (Suzanne Pleshette). However, after his ruse is uncovered, Smith incurs the wrath of the real hired gun, among others, leading to a big shoot-out. (Western, Comedy) - 1971

hdnetmovies.us.title: The Long Riders

The groups of brothers go their separate ways, with Cole Younger (David Carradine) considering settling down with his feisty girlfriend, Belle Starr (Pamela Reed). But they soon regroup for an ill-fated bank job in Northfield, Minn., that results in an epic chase. (Western, Biography) - 1980

hdnetmovies.us.title: Mississippi Burning
hdnetmovies.us.description: When a group of civil rights workers goes missing in a small Mississippi town, FBI agents Alan Ward (Willem Dafoe) and Rupert Anderson (Gene Hackman) are sent in to investigate. Local authorities refuse to cooperate with them, and the African American community is afraid to, precipitating a clash between the two agents over strategy. As the situation becomes more volatile, the direct approach is abandoned in favor of more aggressive, hard-line tactics. (Crime drama, Mystery) - 1988

365blk.us.description: Althea is raped by an acquaintance, and Tibbs is faced with the possibility that they do not have enough evidence to prosecute the man. (Crime drama, Mystery) - 1989-10-24

365blk.us.title: Lethal Weapon 4
365blk.us.description: Detective Riggs (Mel Gibson) tries to settle down with his pregnant girlfriend, Lorna (Rene Russo), while his partner, Murtaugh (Danny Glover), comes to grips with the marriage of his pregnant daughter, Rianne (Traci Wolfe), to fellow cop Butters (Chris Rock). But they find themselves and their families targeted by Chinese mobsters, led by Wah Sing Ku (Jet Li). Riggs, Murtaugh, Butters and private eye Getz (Joe Pesci) decide to go on the offensive before the gangsters get to their loved ones. (Action) - 1998

365blk.us.title: The Commuter
365blk.us.description: Insurance salesman Michael MacCauley is on his daily commute home, which becomes anything but routine. After being contacted by a stranger, Michael is forced to uncover the identity of a hidden passenger on the train before the last stop. As he works against the clock to solve the puzzle, he realizes a plan is unfolding, and he is caught up in a criminal conspiracy that carries life and death stakes for everyone on the train. (Thriller, Mystery, Action) - 2018

365blk.us.title: Who's the Man?
365blk.us.description: Ed Lover (Ed Lover) and Doctor Dre (Andre Romelle Young) are hapless New York City barbers who test the patience of their boss, Nick Crawford (Jim Moody), one too many times and end up at a police academy to try out careers in law enforcement. Training under the tough-as-nails Sergeant Cooper (Denis Leary), Ed and Dre eventually learn enough skills to become rookie cops. For their first major assignment, they attempt to thwart a corrupt businessman at odds with Nick over property development. (Comedy drama, Mystery, Thriller) - 1993

365blk.us.title: Tyler Perry's The Single Moms Club
365blk.us.description: When their children face expulsion because of rule infractions, five single mothers must agree to organize the school's upcoming dance and fundraiser. Although they range from alpha professional to fast-food worker, the women find they have one thing in common: a need for support and an understanding ear. They form the Single Moms Club to help ease one another's burdens and reclaim their freedom. As their stress begins to lessen, the women find that finding love may be possible again. (Comedy drama) - 2014

365blk.us.title: Judge Mathis

bbcearth.us.title: David Attenborough's Natural Curiosities : Seeing The Pattern
bbcearth.us.description: S01 E05 Beautifully patterned or brightly colored animals attract the attention of collectors.

bbcearth.us.title: David Attenborough's Natural Curiosities : Virgin Births
bbcearth.us.description: S02 E01 Female Komodo dragons can reproduce without contact with a male; female aphids can clone themselves to produce copies.

bbcearth.us.title: David Attenborough's Natural Curiosities : Armoured Animals
bbcearth.us.description: S02 E02 Rhinos and hedgehogs protect themselves with body armor in the form of thick skin.

bbcearth.us.title: David Attenborough's Natural Curiosities : Life in the Dark
bbcearth.us.description: S02 E03 Animals adapt to life in the dark; owl eyes are too large to move within their sockets; the giant squid has the largest eyes in the animal kingdom.

bbcearth.us.title: David Attenborough's Natural Curiosities : Curious Imposters
bbcearth.us.description: S02 E04 Sir David Attenborough shines the spotlight on amazing animals; he looks at cuckoos and the way the death's-head hawkmoth steals honey.

bbcearth.us.title: David Attenborough's Natural Curiosities : Bad Reputations
bbcearth.us.description: S02 E05 Sir David Attenborough shines the spotlight on nature's most amazing animals; he takes a closer look at the vampire bat.

bbcearth.us.title: David Attenborough's Natural Curiosities : Shocking Senses
bbcearth.us.description: S02 E06 How naturalists find out that some eels are electric is revealed.

bbcearth.us.title: David Attenborough's Natural Curiosities : Life on Ice
bbcearth.us.description: S02 E07 Sir David Attenborough shines the spotlight on the wood frog, which freezes solid; he looks at how the emperor penguin breeds.

bbcearth.us.title: David Attenborough's Natural Curiosities : Spinners and Weavers
bbcearth.us.description: S02 E08 Nature produces two unique mechanisms of natural construction; weaving in birds and silk fascinate scientists.

bbcearth.us.title: David Attenborough's Natural Curiosities : Strange Parents
bbcearth.us.description: S02 E09 David Attenborough shines the spotlight on female hyenas; he examines why male seahorses give birth.

bbcearth.us.title: David Attenborough's Natural Curiosities : Magical Appearances
bbcearth.us.description: The disappearance of some animals each year puzzled early naturalists; the question arises whether swallows hibernate in mud or underwater and the sudden appearance of butterflies each spring was also a mystery.

bbcearth.us.title: David Attenborough's Natural Curiosities : Impossible Feats
bbcearth.us.description: S03 E01 David Attenborough examines how fleas jump; he tracks the true speed of a cheetah.

bbcearth.us.title: David Attenborough's Natural Curiosities : Curious Minds
bbcearth.us.description: S03 E02 David Attenborough examines orangutans and crows, two unusual animals that use tools.

bbcearth.us.title: David Attenborough's Natural Curiosities : Expandable Bodies
bbcearth.us.description: S03 E03 David Attenborough examines creatures that have fascinated people for centuries; he looks at the expandable bodies of anacondas and camels.

bbcearth.us.title: David Attenborough's Natural Curiosities : Curious Feeders
bbcearth.us.description: S03 E04 A look at some species with unusual styles of consuming food, including the gigantic blue whales and the flamboyant flamingos.

bbcearth.us.title: David Attenborough's Natural Curiosities : Curious Cures
bbcearth.us.description: Humans are not alone in using medicines against injuries and infection and some animals protect themselves with natural remedies in extraordinary ways.

bbcearth.us.title: David Attenborough's Natural Curiosities : Remarkable Regeneration
bbcearth.us.description: A look at the animals who can regenerate entire parts of their bodies.

bbcearth.us.title: David Attenborough's Natural Curiosities : Animal Frankensteins
bbcearth.us.description: S04 E01 Sir David Attenborough examines bizarre and deadly hybrid animals.

bbcearth.us.title: David Attenborough's Natural Curiosities : Finding the Way

bbcearth.us.title: David Attenborough's Natural Curiosities : Extreme Babies
bbcearth.us.description: S04 E03 Sir David Attenborough examines the sizes of animals' young.

bbcearth.us.title: David Attenborough's Natural Curiosities : Curious Counters
bbcearth.us.description: S04 E04 Sir David Attenborough discovers if animals and plants can count.

bbcearth.us.title: David Attenborough's Natural Curiosities : Incredible Shells

bbcearth.us.description: S04 E06 Sir David Attenborough explores animals with fighting behavior.

bbcearth.us.title: Wild Caribbean

bbcearth.us.title: Wild Caribbean

bbcearth.us.title: Wild Caribbean

bbcearth.us.title: Wild Mexico

bbcearth.us.title: Mexico: Earth's Festival of Life

bbcearth.us.title: Wild Mexico
bbcearth.us.description: S01 E03 Burning North A feature on the forces behind Mexico's driest region, and the animals overcoming its conditions.

bbcearth.us.title: Wild Japan

bbcearth.us.title: Wild Japan
bbcearth.us.description: S01 E02 The Southwest Islands In the far south of Japan, there is a place where all life is influenced by the power of the sea, and where volcanoes and typhoons are forces to be reckoned with.

bbcearth.us.title: Wild Japan
bbcearth.us.description: S01 E03 Hokkaido Japan's northernmost island, Hokkaido is a place totally unlike the rest of the country. Every year it swings from a bitter Siberian winter into the warmth of a Mediterranean-like summer.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Far Eastern Odyssey
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E06 Bangladesh Curry is at the top of Rick's list as he ends his culinary tour in Bangladesh.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Mediterranean Escapes
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E01 Corsica and Sardinia Rick Stein discovers sausages and sheep's cheese and explores the locals' passion for chestnuts in Corsica.

bbcfood.us.title: Rachel Khoo's Kitchen Notebook Melbourne
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E01 Rachel explores Melbourne's Chinatown, tastes some of the cities infamous coffee and checks out the new type of restaurant taking over Australia's food-loving capital.

bbcfood.us.title: Rachel Khoo's Kitchen Notebook Melbourne
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E02 Rachel pays a visit to a century-old milk bar and a bar serving up some twists on Aussie classics before meeting up with Kate Gibbs, the granddaughter of legendary Aussie cook Margaret Fulton.

bbcfood.us.title: Rachel Khoo's Kitchen Notebook Melbourne
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E03 Rachel explores some of the city's outer edges, where she discovers authentic and tasty croissants, before meeting up with seasonal cooking advocate Matt Wilkinson.

bbcfood.us.title: Rachel Khoo's Kitchen Notebook Melbourne
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E04 Rachel takes a trip to the Bellarine Peninsula, an up-and-coming foodies' paradise, where she meets up with a mussel trawler, winery owner and cheese maker.

bbcfood.us.title: Rachel Khoo's Kitchen Notebook Melbourne
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E05 Rachel shines a spotlight on Melbourne's sport fanatics' favorite gourmet fast food and cooks up a storm with the city's original food truck proprietor.

bbcfood.us.title: Rachel Khoo's Kitchen Notebook Melbourne
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E06 Keen to explore this melting pot of cuisines, Rachel explores a Vietnamese food market, tracks down a suburban hot bed of Greek eats, and learns how to make passata from an Italian-Australian nonna.

bbcfood.us.title: Rachel Khoo's Kitchen Notebook Melbourne
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E07 Rachel explores one of the lesser-known regions on Melbourne's doorstep, the Dandenongs, where she meets up with Argentinian chef Mauro Callegari.

bbcfood.us.title: Rachel Khoo's Kitchen Notebook Melbourne
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E08 On her last few days in Melbourne, Rachel takes a look at the city's current and future food trends and throws a barbecue party for the foodies she has met during her time in Australia.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Secret France
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E01 Dieppe Rick Stein embarks on a new journey through the byways of France, from the Channel to the Mediterranean, always on the lookout for things where the British could learn from the French to enhance lives.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Secret France
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E02 Alsace and Jura Rick Stein goes through France's eastern border regions of Alsace and Jura home to his favorite French dish, choucroute garni and favorite French cheese, comté.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Secret France
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E03 Burgundy Rick Stein continues exploring Burgundy and practices a little entente cordiale with a château owner who cooks him sorrel soup straight out of the garden.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Secret France
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E04 Perigord Rick Stein arrives in the region of Perigord, famous for decadent dishes; he discovers his favorite market in the city of Perigueux and learns about the region's historical relationship with England as the former kingdom of Aquitaine.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Secret France
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E05 Roussillon Rick Stein's journey of discovery brings him to the sunnier climes of the Mediterranean, where he explores the French-Catalan legacy of Roussillon on the foothills of the Pyrenees next to the Spanish border.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Secret France
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E06 Languedoc Rick Stein approaches the end of his meander through France with a final glance at the culinary delights of the Languedoc before crossing over to Provence and the Mediterranean coastline that reveals new insights into southern French cuisine.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein From Venice to Istanbul
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E01 Rick's journey begins in the magnificent city of Venice and on the idyllic Greek island of Symi he cooks some of his favorite Venetian dishes: seafood risotto, tiramisu and gnocchi with spider crab.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein From Venice to Istanbul
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E02 Rick Stein continues his gastronomic journey from Venice to Istanbul; in the Byzantine city of Ravenna he discovers Piadinas, street food dating back to Roman times.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein From Venice to Istanbul
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E03 Rick Stein continues his Byzantine odyssey through Croatia and savours the famous native oysters of Ston; he then crosses the border to Albania, a country loved by Lord Byron.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein From Venice to Istanbul
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E04 Rick Stein's gastronomic journey from Venice to Istanbul brings him to Northern Greece and the historic city of Ioannina where he tastes a traditional Veal Stifado and Kotopita.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein From Venice to Istanbul
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E05 Rick Stein arrives in the Greek Peloponnese and samples memorable dishes like rooster stew hilopites with mizithra cheese and the best home-made moussaka he's ever had; in his Symi island kitchen, he cooks galaktoboureko.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein From Venice to Istanbul
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E06 Turkey Rick Stein's journey from Venice to Istanbul is nearing its completion as he leaves southern Greece for the shores of Western Turkey.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein From Venice to Istanbul
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E07 Rick Stein's culinary odyssey ends in the legendary city of Istanbul where he enjoys a fishing expedition on the Bosphorus and cooks lavish kofte kebabs with pistachios.

bbcfood.us.title: Rachel Khoo's Kitchen Notebook: London
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E01 Fashion Rachel celebrates the quirkiness and individuality of London fashion in her kitchen, proving it's more about creativity than the price tag when it comes to getting your food looking and tasting good.

crunchyroll.us.title: Fractale
crunchyroll.us.description: S01 E04 Departure When the Granites nab Phryne during the Star Festival ambush, the temple authorities retaliate with an attack on the secret village in hopes of recovering the priestess.

crunchyroll.us.title: Fractale
crunchyroll.us.description: S01 E05 Journey A glitch in the Granites' getaway ship has them stumped, but Clain uses his hacking skills to reveal a mischievous "doppel" that can't resist a game of hide and seek.

crunchyroll.us.title: Fractale
crunchyroll.us.description: S01 E06 The Farthest Town The Granites land their ship out of range of the Fractale system to make repairs; Clain and Phryne take in an eye-opening view of the effects of Fractale's failing structures after they meet a lone antique collector.

crunchyroll.us.title: Fractale
crunchyroll.us.description: S01 E07 Veneer Town After they crash their ship, Clain and an ill Nessa find themselves in the extravagant city of Xanadu under the care of deceptively friendly "doppels."

crunchyroll.us.title: Fractale
crunchyroll.us.description: S01 E08 Secret of the Underground The high priest holds Phryne and the wounded Clain in an underground base; a Nessa look-alike shows Clain how much the temple cherishes Phryne; Sunda recruits the other Lost Millennium factions for a rescue mission.

crunchyroll.us.title: Fractale
crunchyroll.us.description: S01 E09 No Way Out After the Granites lift Clain, Phryne and Nessa safely from the rubble of the destroyed lab, the factions of the Lost Millennium face the fateful decision to unite for their best shot to bring Fractale down or surrender.

crunchyroll.us.title: Fractale
crunchyroll.us.description: S01 E10 To the Temple The battle between the Lost Millennium and the temple's forces rages on; Phryne reaches the Archpriestess and pleads to end the war and let Fractale fade out.

crunchyroll.us.title: Fractale
crunchyroll.us.description: S01 E11 Paradise Clain is helpless behind a wall as Barrot details Phryne's role in the system, but the priest's demented rant is cut short; as the temple begins to collapse and Nessa starts to fade, the future of Fractale and all of mankind lies in Phryne's hands.

crunchyroll.us.title: Steins;Gate
crunchyroll.us.description: S01 E05 Starmine Rendezvous After some late night modifications to the IBN-5100, Okabe and his team uncover the shocking truth behind SERN's many attempts to master time travel.

crunchyroll.us.title: Steins;Gate
crunchyroll.us.description: S01 E06 Butterfly Effect's Divergence Makise figures out the rules to the phone microwave, now known as D-Mail; Okabe reluctantly adds a new member to the Future Gadget Lab staff.

crunchyroll.us.title: Steins;Gate
crunchyroll.us.description: S01 E07 Divergence Singularity Okabe takes his experimentation to the next level by texting the winning lotto numbers back in time, but he fails to consider how his actions might alter the present or the future.

crunchyroll.us.title: Steins;Gate
crunchyroll.us.description: S01 E08 Chaos Theory Homeostasis - I The latest experiment for Okabe and his lab mates leads to the disappearance of one of their own; they attempt to use their time travel technology to make a young boy's dream a reality.

crunchyroll.us.title: Steins;Gate
crunchyroll.us.description: S01 E09 Chaos Theory Homeostasis - II Okabe grows concerned over the drastic changes his experimentation causes, and the IBN-5100 disappears from the lab; the only hope for finding a replacement rests upon the delicate shoulders of Feyris the cat girl.

crunchyroll.us.title: Steins;Gate
crunchyroll.us.description: S01 E10 Chaos Theory Homeostasis - III The part-time warrior from downstairs tells Okabe about the search for her missing father; a mysterious text message troubles the aspiring mad scientist.

crunchyroll.us.title: Steins;Gate
crunchyroll.us.description: S01 E11 Dogma in Event Horizon As the lab members prepare to transport human memories by way of a Time Leap, Okabe receives some highly disturbing news that Makise may be a SERN spy.

crunchyroll.us.title: Steins;Gate
crunchyroll.us.description: S01 E12 Dogma in Ergosphere Tension builds at the Lab when Makise and Suzuha both show up for the party; as the night draws to a close, armed thugs led by a familiar face come looking for the time machine.

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Prom Night
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: This slasher movie follows a relentless killer who is out to avenge the death of a young girl who died after being bullied and teased by four of her classmates. Now high-school students, the guilt-ridden kids have kept their involvement a secret, but when they start being murdered, one by one, it's clear that someone knows the truth. Also coping with the past are members of the dead girl's family, most notably her prom-queen sister, Kim Hammond. (Horror, Thriller) - 1980

But when two FBI agents set him up for murder, he must now go on the run to clear his name and bring them to justice. (Action, Thriller) - 2020

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: The Contract
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: Frank Carden (Morgan Freeman), one of the world's greatest assassins, is handed a lucrative contract to kill a highly secretive billionaire. But in a twist of fate, Carden is involved in a car accident during the job, and when his gun is found after he is admitted to a hospital, federal marshals arrest him. Meanwhile, ex-cop Ray Keene (John Cusack) is hiking with his son, Chris (Jamie Anderson), when Carden's cohorts try to spring him from custody, and soon the pair is caught in the crossfire. (Thriller) - 2006

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: The Getaway
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: Doc and Carol McCoy are married criminals looking for a high-paying score. When Doc ends up in a Mexican prison, Carol tells mob boss Jack Benyon that Doc will work for him if Benyon can free him from prison. Benyon hires Doc to rob a dog track, but after the heist goes terribly wrong, Doc and Carol escape with the cash. With a bitter thief and Benyon's hired help on their trail, Doc and Carol must fight to survive. (Action, Adventure, Crime drama, Thriller) - 1994

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Going All the Way
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: Korean War--era veterans and ex-classmates "Gunner" Casselman (Ben Affleck) and "Sonny" Burns (Jeremy Davies) reunite upon their return home. Gunner, who spent the war years abroad, is trying to convince his mother that his gal Marty (Rachel Weisz) is good enough for him, while Sonny, who was stationed stateside, is torn between loyal Buddy (Amy Locane) and tempting Gale Ann (Rose McGowan). As they commiserate, the men realize that they're outgrowing the lives they lived before the war. (Drama) - 1997

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Homeboy

motortrendfasttv.us.description: Joe Martin and his crew are always under the gun, but their latest build, a '71 Nova, is well behind schedule, and they have a ton of work to do; Joe is really going to town on the metal work on this car, inside and out. paranormalfiles.us.description: In April 2011 the FBI declassified decades' worth of secret government documents that contain thousands of reports of UFO sightings and alien activity. Each episode of this half-hour series tackles one alien case by investigating the previously off-limits government files. The program re-examines key evidence and follows developing leads based on newly released information. Mass UFO sightings, personal abductions, government cover-ups, and alien news from around the world are some of the topics covered by the show's panel of specialists, who include journalists, researchers, and radio and TV hosts. The day-long event is set to include activities ranging from horseback rides to sunrise yoga that will last well into the night. The party turns into a Tapas Dinner.

portlandia.us.title: Portlandia

portlandia.us.title: Portlandia

portlandia.us.title: Portlandia

portlandia.us.title: Portlandia

portlandia.us.title: Portlandia
portlandia.us.description: S04 E02 Ecoterrorists Ecoterrorists protest animal testing at a makeup company; Bryce and Lisa Rent it Out!; Toni and Candace have a car wash; Fred misses hip hop; Dave helps Kath get a good night's sleep.

portlandia.us.title: Portlandia

portlandia.us.title: Portlandia

portlandia.us.title: Portlandia

portlandia.us.title: Portlandia
portlandia.us.description: S04 E07 Trailblazers Toni and Candace coach a dance team; Kickstarter videos compete at a Film Festival; Toni and Candace coach the Portland Trail Blazers' dance team.
